Name: SRI JUSTICE A ABHISHEK REDDY
Biodata: Honourable Sri Justice A.Abhishek Reddy is the son Sri A.Pulla Reddy, Advocate, and Smt.Dr.A.Shashirekha Reddy, born on 07th November, 1967, and hails from Lingampally village, Manchal Mandal, Ranga Reddy District. He has done his schooling from St.Pauls High School, Hyderguda, Intermediate from Little Flower Junior College, Uppal. On completion of graduation in Arts from Nizam College, Hyderabad, obtained Law Degree from University College of Law, Osmania University, in the year 1990 and enrolled as Advocate in the erstwhile Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh at Hyderabad, in July, 1990. After enrolment, he has joined the chambers of his father Sri A.Pulla Reddy (one of the senior most Members of the Bar, practising Law from 1952 onwards). He has practised in various branches of Law before various Tribunals, Forums, Revenue authorities and Courts including District Court, Ranga Reddy District, City Civil Court, Hyderabad, and the High Court of Andhra Pradesh and handled cases mainly involving Constitutional, Arbitration, Administration, Civil, Family, Revenue, Land Acquisition, and various other branches of Law, both on the original and appellate side. He completed his LL.M. from Washington College of Law, The American University, Washington D.C., in the year 1993 and resumed practise. He was appointed as Government Pleader-cum-Public Prosecutor in the Special Court under A.P.Land Grabbing Prohibition Act in the year 2004 and worked as Government Pleader for Higher and Technical Education, in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh from 2007 to 2009. He was the Standing Counsel for many institutions including Telangana State Council of Higher Education TSCHE, Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University JNTU, Hyderabad, Jawaharlal Nehru Architecture and Fine Arts University JNAFAU, Telangana Fee Regulatory Committee TFRC and various other organizations in the High Court. He has appeared on behalf of Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Authority HMDA, Telangana State Board of Intermediate Education TSBIE, Chattisgarh Board of Secondary Education, Pondicherry Urban Development Agency PUDA, Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation GHMC and State Board of Technical Education and Training SBTET in the High Court for the State of Telangana at Hyderabad. Elevated to the Bench as Permanent Judge, High Court for the State of Telangana at Hyderabad, on 26th August, 2019.
LLM_Institutition: Washington College of Law, The American University, Washington D.C.

Name: SRI JUSTICE A. GANGADHARA RAO
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice A. Gangadhara Rao was born on 1st July, 1921 in Nellore District. After having scholastic career, passed his Intermediate examination with distinction in History. Graduation from Madras University from 1940 and obtained his Law Degree from Bombay University. Secured First Class in LL.B. Enrolled as an Advocate of the Bombay High Court in the year 1948 and practised at Nellore from 1948 to 1954. Shifted to Guntur and later to Hyderabad and set up his practice in the High Court. Worked in the Chambers of late Sri Justice M. Seshachalapati who was then the Government Pleader. Was appointed as Additional Public Prosecutor and worked in that capacity from 1966 to 1969. He was also elected as President, High Court Advocates’ Association during 1973-74. Associated himself with student movement and was detained for about one year in 1942 in Central Jail, Vellore. Awarded Tamrapatra in 1974. Attended the World Conference for Peace and Disarmament as a Member of the Indian Delegation at Stockholm in Sweden in 1958. A social worker and Vice-President of Andhra Mahila Sabha Trust Board Elevated as an Additional Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court for a period of 2 years from 7.3.1975 and later appointed as permanent Judge of the A.P. High Court from 30.6.1976. He retired on 1.7.1983 F.N.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE A. GOPAL RAO
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice A. Gopal Rao was born on 15.7.1934 at Madanapalle, Chittoor District. Passed B.Sc.LL.B. Science graduate from the Presidency College of Madras. Law Degree from the Osmania University in the year 1958. Enrolled as an Advocate of High Court of Andhra Pradesh in the year 1959. Name: SRI JUSTICE A. GOPAL REDDY
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice A. Gopal Reddy was born in an agriculturist family on 20th December, 1949 in Indupriyal village, Doulatabad Mandal, Medak District of Andhra Pradesh, India. He had Primary education in the village school at Narsingi, Medak District. High School education in Zilla Parishad High School at Alwal. Studied PUC in New Science College, Hyderabad. Obtained B.A., degree from Sardar Patel college, Hyderabad. Obtained Law Degree in the year 1977 from Osmania University. Enrolled as an Advocate in the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh on 02.02.1978 and joined in the office of Sri Upendralal Waghray who was later elevated to the Bench in July, 1983. Since then practiced independently in High Court and City Civil Courts, Hyderabad., Appointed as Additional Central Government standing Counsel for three years in the month of August, 1995. Appointed as Government pleader for Endowments, Forest, Environment and Energy for three years w.e.f., 28.07.1997. Standing Counsel for Canara Bank; Power Grid Corporation of India; M/s Ceat India Limited; Hyderabad Public School, Begumpet, Ramanthapur, Hyderabad; Andhra Mahila Sabha Arts & Science college, Hyderabad and panel Advocate for State Bank of India and State Bank of Hyderabad. Appointed as Additional Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh w.e.f.17.05.1999 and as Judge w.e.f. 20.04.2000. Retired on attaining the age of Superannuation ie., 62 years, on 19.12.2011 A.N.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE A. RAMALINGESWARA RAO
Biodata: Born on 21-5-1956 in West Godavari District of Andhra Pradesh. A first class student from school days, obtained a bachelor degree in Commerce from Andhra University. Took his LL.B. and LL.M.(International Law) Degrees from Osmania University, Hyderabad. He is a ‘Jyotish Visharad’ from Indian Council of Astrological Sciences, Chennai and possesses M.A. Astrology degree from Potti Sriramulu Telugu University, Hyderabad. He possesses a certificate in Intellectual Property Rights from Indian Law Institute, New Delhi. He was a Fellow of Bar Council of India Trust during 1983-84. He was a part time Lecturer in Law teaching International Law to Post Graduate students in Osmania University during 1984-85., After completing Post Graduate studies in Law, he was enrolled as an Advocate in 1982 and joined the office of Sri Justice A. Venkatarami Reddy in 1984 and set up independent practice in 1987, after his Senior's elevation. Since then he was practising actively in all branches of law till his elevation on 21.09.2013. He is a champion of public interest and social justice and argued several cases of public interest including the Medical Colleges case against capitation fee (1992 (3) ALT 99), Prohibition Case (AIR 1997 AP 312) and Environmental cases. The case argued for protection of forests in agency areas is well known all over India as Samatha case (AIR 1997 SC 3297). He was a Government Pleader assisting the then Advocates General in 1995 & 1996. He was Counsel for T.T.D., A.P. Pollution Control Board, National Institute of Open Schooling, New Delhi, United India Insurance Co. Ltd., and Bajaj Allianz Insurance Co. Ltd., He is a voracious reader and has keen interest in literature and arts. He writes occasionally. He delivered judgments in more than 13000 cases since elevation and more than 100 of them are reported in law journals. He edited a "handbook for dispute resolvers under ADR processes".

Name: SRI JUSTICE A. RANGANADHAM CHETTY

Name: SRI JUSTICE A. SHANKAR NARAYANA
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Ambati Shankar Narayana born to Sri A. Venkataiah and Smt. A. Venkata Subbamma, on 01-07-1956 at Dhone in Kurnool District. His father was a retired Judicial Officer., Did B.Sc., graduation from Nanakram Bhagwan Das Science College, Hyderabad. After graduation, did his Law Degree and LL.M.(Evening College) from Osmania University, Hyderabad., After completion of Law Course, enrolled as an Advocate in 1979, and practiced in various Courts in twin Cities of Hyderabad and Secunderabad and also in Ranga Reddy District Courts., While practicing as an Advocate, got selected as District Munsif {now called as Civil Judge (Junior Division)} and was appointed on 07-10-1985, and worked as such till 1992 and subsequently, promoted as Subordinate Judge {now called as Civil Judge (Senior Division)} in the month of May, 1992 and worked as such till part of October, 1999. Thereafter, promoted as Additional District Judge in the month of October, 1999 and worked as such at various stations viz., Principal Special Judge for SPE & ACB Cases, City Civil Court, Hyderabad, Registrar Judicial, High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad, Registrar of Lokayukta, Principal District & Sessions Judge, Krishna District, Registrar Management and Registrar Vigilance of High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad., Elevated as an Additional Judge to the High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad, on 23-10-2013., Appointed as Judge of High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on the afternoon of 02-03-2016.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE A.RAJASHEKER REDDY
Biodata: Born on 04.05.1960 in an agricultural family at Sirsangandla Village, Peddavoora Mandal of Nalgonda District. His parents are Sri A. Ramanuja Reddy and Smt. A. Jayaprada. Had his primary education in St. Marys High School at Miryalaguda and in St. Alphonsus High School at Nalgonda. Studied Intermediate in New Science College, Hyderabad. Graduated from A.V. College, Hyderabad. Did his Bachelors Degree in Law from Kakatiya University. Awarded gold medal in Law. He was enrolled in Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh in April, 1985 and joined in the Office of Sri Mahamood Ali. After four years, he started practice independently. He almost exclusively practised in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh and conducted several cases on civil, taxation, criminal and constitutional side. He also practised on original side for some time. He was elected as Vice President of the A.P. High Court Advocates Association in the year 2004. He was appointed as Senior Standing Counsel for Central Government in the year 2004 which was re-designated as Assistant Solicitor General of India in the year 2005. He continued as Assistant Solicitor General till 2009. He was also appointed as Senior Standing Counsel for Central Excise, Customs and Service Tax. He was designated as Senior Counsel by High Court of A.P., Hyderabad in the year 2012. He was also the Counsel for Software Technology Parks of India, National Construction Corporation and BSNL. He is interested in music especially old songs. He was elevated as Additional Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh and sworn-in on 12.04.2013. Appointed as Judge of the High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on 08.09.2014.

Name: Sri Justice Ahsanuddin Amanullah
Biodata: Born on 11-05-1963; pursued B.Sc. (Hons.) Chemistry and LL.B. Enrolled with the Bihar State Bar Council on 27-09-1991. Practiced majorly in the Constitutional Courts, primarily Patna High Court; appeared intermittently before the Hon'ble Supreme Court, and Calcutta, Jharkhand and Delhi High Courts, inter alia, in Constitutional, Civil, Criminal, Service, Co-operative, Taxation, Labour, Corporate, Forest matters; specialised in Constitutional and Service laws. Appeared in the Central Administrative Tribunal, Commercial Taxes Tribunal, Board of Revenue, District Courts, Consumer Disputes Redressal bodies, and in some arbitrations. Standing Counsel, Government of Bihar (Mar. 2006 - Aug. 2010) and Government Advocate, State of Bihar (Aug. 2010 till elevation) [Patna High Court]; Special Counsel, Income-Tax Department, Government of India [Jharkhand High Court] and; Counsel for the District Administration before the Commission of Inquiry into the Dalsingsarai Samastipur firing incident. The Advocate-General, Bihar nominated him to represent State of Maharashtra, Maharashtra Police and Mumbai Police, upon special request by the Advocate-General, Maharashtra. Represented various institutional and individual clients, including, but not limited to, the Indian Railways, Unit Trust of India, Union Bank of India, RITES (previously Rail India Technical and Economic Services Limited), Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited IRCTC, Bihar State Housing Board, Bihar State Electricity Board, Bihar State Text Book Publishing Corporation, Bihar State Cooperative Bank Limited, Bihar State Cooperative Marketing Union Limited BISCOMAUN, Bihar Cooperative Land Development Bank Limited, Bihar State Agricultural Marketing Board, various Agricultural Produce Market Committees in Bihar, Bihar State Housing Cooperative Federation, Bihar State Credit and Investment Corporation BICICO, Commercial Taxes Department (Government of Bihar), Magadh University Gaya, Veer Kuer Singh University Arrah, Bihar Industrial Area Development Authority, Bihar State Health Society, BSACS, Mahindra and Mahindra, Samsung Corporation Engineering & Construction Group etc. Empanelled by the Patna Legal Aid Committee (precursor to High Court Legal Services Committee) for Criminal Appeals. Amicus Curiae in matters of significance; associated with social issues pro bono. Instrumental in drafting and vetting subordinate and delegated legislation for certain Acts of the Bihar Legislature during 2006-2011. Assistant Returning Officer for elections to the Bihar State Bar Council (2002) and Jharkhand State Bar Council (2006). Upon invitation, addressed Indian Administrative Service probationers at the Lal Bahadur Shastri National Academy of Administration. Participated in the Bar Council of India Trust nter-University Moot Court Competition, 1989 at Himachal Pradesh University, Shimla. Elevated as Judge, Patna High Court on 20-06-2011. Upon transfer, joined High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 10-10-2021. At the Patna High Court, had been Chairman, High Court Legal Services Committee; Chairman, Juvenile Justice Monitoring Committee, and; Member, Board of Governors, Bihar Judicial Academy, Patna. Appointed as Executive Chairman, Andhra Pradesh State Legal Services Authority on 08-11-2021.

Name: Sri Justice Akula Venkata Sesha Sai
Biodata: Born in the year 1962 in an Agricultural and Freedom Fighters’ family at Bhimavaram, West Godavari District. College, Bhimavaram and B.L. Degree in Sir C.R. Reddy College, Eluru, West Godavari District (Andhra University). Enrolled as an Advocate on the rolls of the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh on 03.07.1987 and joined the Chambers of Sri P.Rajagopala Rao and also worked in the chambers of late Sri P.Raja Rao. Actively Practised in Civil, Criminal, Services, Constitutional and almost all other branches of Law. Had developed his independent practice with in short span of time and extensively dealt with number of cases, covering all branches of Law. Deeply interested in philosophy, culture, music and education. Was Standing Counsel for Municipal Corporation of Hyderabad and was a panel Advocate for the State Bar Council and was an Advocate for the State of Andhra Pradesh in the Suit pertaining to Polavaram Project instituted by the State of Orissa in the Hon'ble Supreme Court. Elevated as Additional Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh and sworn in on 12.04.2013. Appointed as Judge of the High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on 08.09.2014.

Had his primary education in Municipal Elementary School, Bhimavaram and Higher Education in Luthern High School, Bhimavaram and Intermediate in K.G.R.L. College, Bhimavaram and graduation in D.N.R. College, Bhimavaram and B.L. Degree in Sir C.R. Reddy College, Eluru, West Godavari District (Andhra University). Enrolled as an Advocate on the rolls of the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh on 03.07.1987 and joined the Chambers of Sri P.Rajagopala Rao and also worked in the chambers of late Sri P.Raja Rao. Actively Practised in Civil, Criminal, Services, Constitutional and almost all other branches of Law. Had developed his independent practice with in short span of time and extensively dealt with number of cases, covering all branches of Law. Deeply interested in philosophy, culture, music and education. Was Standing Counsel for Municipal Corporation of Hyderabad and was a panel Advocate for the State Bar Council and was an Advocate for the State of Andhra Pradesh in the Suit pertaining to Polavaram Project instituted by the State of Orissa in the Hon'ble Supreme Court. Elevated as Additional Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh and sworn in on 12.04.2013. Appointed as Judge of the High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on 08.09.2014.

Name: SRI JUSTICE ALLADI KUPPU SWAMI
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice A. Kuppuswami was born on March 23, 1920. Educated at Madras in Layola College and Law College. Took B.A. (Hons.) Mathematics Degree in First Class in 1939. Studied Law in 1939-41. Apprentice at Law under late Sri V. Govindarajachari. Enrolled as an Advocate on 3.8.1942. Member of the Bar Council of A.P. – 1961-67., Appointed as an Additional Judge on 21.8.1967 and permanent Judge on 27.11.1967. Was appointed as Acting Chief Justice on 23.6.1980 and as permanent Chief Justice on 23.11.1980., Appointed as One-Man Commission to enquire into the lathi charge on S.S.P. Members opposite Parliament House in 1970 and also to enquire into AVRO Air Crash at Hyderabad in 1973 and to enquire into the irregularities in respect of a contract regarding Nagarjunasagar Canal in 1974. President, SURA BHARATHI SAMITHI, Hyderabad and Chairman, Hyderabad Literary Society.

Name: SRI JUSTICE ANIL RAMESH DAVE
Biodata: Born on 19.11.1951.Did B.Com., LL.M., A.C.A (Chartered Accountant). Was Recipient of National Scholarship for LL.M. studies.Enrolled as an Advocate on 25.7.1976., Was Solicitor to the Govt. of Gujarat and Additional Govt. Pleader, Gujarat High Court from April 1986 to August 1994 for conducting its matters arising under labour laws and service matters. Appeared before the High Court for several statutory bodies like Gujarat Public Service Commission, GEER and for several District Panchayats., Was part-time Lecturer in Sir L. A. Shah Law College from 1976 to September 1995. Also taught LL.M. students for about a year.Elevated to the Bench of Gujarat High Court as Additional Judge on 18.9.1995 and confirmed as Permanent Judge on 18.6.1997.Appointed as Chief Justice of Andhra Pradesh High Court and assumed charge on 7.1.2008 F.N., Transferred as the Chief Justice of Bombay High Court and relinquished the charge of office on the forenoon of 11.02.2010.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE AR.LAKSHMANAN
Biodata: Justice AR. Lakshmanan was born on March 22nd 1942 at Devakottai, Sivaganga District, Tamil Nadu. He enrolled as Lawyer on January 10, 1968 at Madras High Court.Was nominated as Senior Advocate by the Government of Tamil Nadu to impart training to the selected Law Graduates belonging to the Backward Classes under the Scheme, formulated by the Government of Tamil Nadu.Was appointed as Government Pleader, High Court by the Government of Tamil Nadu on 22.3.1989.Was appointed as a Permanent Judge of the madras High Court, on 14.6.1990 by His Excellency the President of India., He is the recipient of “Shiromani Vikas Award” for National Integration and Development from His Excellency the Governor of Tamil Nadu.He is the recipient of “Vijay Shree Award” for his professional excellence. The award was instituted by the International Friendship Society of India, New Delhi., On 4.12.1997, he was transferred to Kerala High Court.Remained Acting Chief Justice, High Court of Kerala from 23.5.1999 to 20.9.1999 and again from 8.5.2000 onwards. “Doctor of Laws” was conferred by the Governor of Tamil Nadu/ and Chancellor of Annamali University, Chidambaram, Tamil Nadu on Justice AR. Lakshmanan as an eminent legal luminary, rendering distinguished services as an outstanding Judge and Champion of Human Rights on 10.1.2000. He was Chief Justice, High Court of Judicature for Rajasthan from 29.5.2000., He has sworned in as Chief Justice, High Court of A.P on 26.11.2001. He was elevated as Judge to Supreme Court of India on 20.12.2002 F.N.]

Name: Sri Justice B. Krishna Mohan
Biodata: Hon'ble Justice B. Krishna Mohan was born on 05-02-1965 at Guntur. His Lordship's father late Sri B.S. R. Anjaneyulu was a District and Sessions Judge in Andhra Pradesh State Higher Judicial Service. His Lordship studied in Majeti Guruvaiah High School, Guntur; graduated in Sciences from Hindu College, Guntur; obtained law degree from Andhra Christian Law College, Guntur affiliated to Acharya Nagarjuna University. Enrolled on 30-03-1989 in the State Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh at Hyderabad and started High Court practice by joining the office of late Sri C. Trivikrama Rao and set up an independent practice in the year 1993. His Lordship's wife Smt. B. Vasantha Lakshmi, daughter of late Sri. Justice K. R. Prasad Rao, former Judge of Karnataka High Court and the Vice-Chairman of the Central Administrative Tribunal, Hyderabad is also a practicing Advocate. His Lordship worked as Assistant Government Pleader for Home, Law and Legislative Affairs in the High Court between 1996 to 1999. Rendered services as Central Government Counsel from 2008 to 2018, Standing Counsel for University Grants Commission, Food Corporation of India, AIIMS, New Delhi and Navodaya Schools; Legal Adviser to State Bank of Mysore, Canara Bank, Vijaya Bank, VRL Logistics, GATI Ltd and Standing Counsel for NREDCAP. His Lordship was appointed as the first Assistant Solicitor General of India for the High Court of Andhra Pradesh at Amaravti on 10th January, 2019 and continued in the said office till elevation as a Judge of this Hon'ble High Court. His Lordship was sworn in as a Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 02-05-2020.
LLB_Institutition: Andhra Christian Law College, Nagarjuna University

Name: SRI JUSTICE B.CHANDRA KUMAR
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Bejjaram Chandra Kumar was born on 7.1.1953 in Adilabad District. Son of Smt.Bhagirathibai and B.Ramachander. Father was a Freedom Fighter and worked as a teacher. Had college education at Adilabad. Associated with cultural and literary and social organizations in Adilabad District. Obtained Law Degree from Osmania University in the year 1978. Worked for some time with Hon'ble Sri Justice Sardar Ali Khan. Practised as an Advocate at Adilabad from 1978 to 1988. Married Smt. S.Narmada in the year 1980. Shifted from Adilabad to Hyderabad in the year 1988 and practiced in High Court of Andhra Pradesh and other Courts and Tribunals. Selected as District Judge by direct recruitment in the year 1993 and worked as Additional District Judge at Mahaboobnagar, Chittoor, Tirupati, Nellore. Also worked as Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad, Special Judge for SPE and ACB Cases, Hyderabad, Chairman, Industrial Tribunal, Ananthapur and Chairman, Sales Tax Tribunal, Hyderabad and as Chief Judge, City Civil Court, Hyderabad., Awarded title as “The Great Son of the Soil” by All India Conference of Intellectuals on 21st August 2010. , Author of Poetry, dramas, stories. Published books are; (1) Naa Kalamlo Inkaipoindi, (2) Sai Bhakti Geetalu and (3) Neevu Maaku Adarsham, and has written several articles published in several Newspapers. He has been chosen as President of Lead India 2020 Foundation. Has been visiting Schools, Colleges and Hostels and interacting with the students and motivating them to become responsible citizens., Elevated as Additional Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 05.02.2009. Appointed as Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such, on 26.11.2010. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on the afternoon of 06-01-2015.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE B.J.DIVAN
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice B.J.Divan was born on 20th August 1919, educated at Proprietary High School, Ahmedabad, Wilson College and Government Law College, Bombay and University School of Economics and Sociology, Bombay. Enrolled as an Advocate of Bombay High Court on the Appellate Side in September, 1941 and on the Original Side in September, 1943 and practiced there from 1943 to 1954. Appointed as Judge, Bombay City Civil Court and Additional Sessions Judge Greater Bombay on 4th November, 1954. Principal Judge, Bombay City Civil Court and Sessions Judge Greater Bombay on 1st May 1961., Appointed as Additional Judge of Gujarat High Court from 19th April, 1962. Permanent Judge with effect from 23rd September, 1963., Appointed Chief Justice, Gujarat High Court from 17th July 1973. Transferred to Andhra Pradesh High Court with effect from 1st July, 1976. Acted as Governor of Andhra Pradesh from 17th February, 1977 F.N. till 5th May, 1977 F.N. Re-transferred to Gujarat High Court as Chief Justice with effect from 28th August, 1977. Retired on 20th August, 1981.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE B.N.RAO NALLA
Biodata: Born on 12-06-1951 at Bhimavaram Village of Medipalli Mandal, Metpalli Taluq of Karimnagar District. Had primary education at Native Place. Had High School education at M.P.H.S.S.(Multi Purpose Higher Secondary School), Jagtiyal. During 1969 Telangana Movement, he joined Central School, Colaba, Bombay. Pursued Intermediate Studies at Government Junior College, Koratla and did his graduation from City College, Hyderabad. Graduated and Post graduated in Law from University of Bombay. Practiced Law in Bombay. Enrolled on the Bar Council of Maharasthra and Goa on 17-11-1978. Worked as part-time Law Professor in Bombay from the Academic year 1982-83 to 1989-90. Resigned the said position in the year 1990 and shifted his practice to Hyderabad. He practiced in High Court, Ranga Reddy District Court, City Courts, etc. The Bar Council of India at New Delhi passed a resolution in his favour on 6th December, 1992, whereby it directed the Bar Council of Maharastra and Goa to send his proceeding to Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh and also directed the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh to enroll him on its rolls from his original date of enrolment i.e., 17-11-1978., In the year 1993, he was recruited directly as District Judge., He took charge as ADJ of (1) Srikakulam on 18-10-1993 and thereafter he worked as (2) III ADJ and (3) II ADJ of Kurnool District (4) Senior faculty member of A.P.JA., Secunderabad (5) Spl. Judge for Economic Offences, Hyderabad (6) Chairman, A.P. Co-operative Appellate Tribunal, Hyderabad (7) Addl. Chief Judge, City Small Causes Court, Hyderabad (8) ADJ, Khammam (9) Prl. D.J., Mahabubnagar (10) Director of Prosecutions, Hyderabad (11) Prl. D.J., Srikakulam (12) The Registrar, A.P.A.T., Hyderabad (13) The Chairman, Sales-Tax Appellate Tribunal, Vizag., Providence has given him a devoted wife Smt. Srilaxmi, B.sc Hons; B.Ed Maths, who is born, brought up and educated in Bombay. She is a former teacher of Modern Maths, Physics and Chemistry of St. George's Grammer School, Abids, Hyderabad the second anicient convent school in whole of south India and St.Joseph Public School, King Koti, Hyderabad. Blessed with 3 children., (1) Srinivas Rao, son, graduated from IIT, Bombay who worked as Chief Engineer, M/s Epson International, Singapore, presently holding the position of Business Development Manager in L & T, Atlanta, U.S.A. Married Meenakshi, MBA. He is blessed with a son Saurish Rao and two daughters Srika and Sarika., (2) Gayathri, daughter, graduated in medicine. Married and settled in America. She is blessed with a son Gaurav. Providence has given him a son-in-law Ravikiran, Software, who is more a son than a son-in-law., (3) Sreedhar Rao, son, graduated from National Institute of Fashion Technology and at present working with an international company in China as Sales Manager., Elevated as Addl. Judge, High Court of A.P., on 14-10-2009. Appointed as Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such, on 26-11-2010. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on the afternoon of 11-06-2013.]
LLM_Institutition: University Department of Law, University of Mumbai

Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice B. Prakash Rao was born on 25th May, 1949 in the village of Kolpak of Armoor Taluq in Nizambad District of Andhra Pradesh, India. Justice B. Prakash Rao had his higher secondary education in Jagtial of Karimnagar District. Graduated in the year 1969 from New Science College, Hyderabad and obtained Law Degree from the Osmania University in the year 1972., Enrolled as an Advocate in the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh in September, 1972 and joined the Office of late Sri M.L. Name: SRI JUSTICE B.S. RAIKOTE
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice B.S. Raikote was born on 07.10.1937 at Shahapur Village in Gulbarga District of Karnataka State. Obtained M.A., LL.M., Degrees and did M.A. in Philosophy from Karnataka University, Dharwar in the year 1961. Obtained LL.M., with first rank from Karnataka University, Dharwar in the 1965. Enrolled as an Advocate in the year 1965. Joined as Junior under Sri M. Nagappa, Advocate at Arichur from 1966 to 1968. In 1968 shifted practice to the High Court of Karnataka in Bangalore. Retired on 07.10.1999.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE B.S.A.SWAMY
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice B. Sri Atchuthananda Swamy was born on Eleventh July Nineteen Forty Two (11.07.1942) at Mukteswaram, Ainavalli Mandal, East Godavari District of Andhra Pradesh, India. Obtained B.Sc., Degree from S.K.B.R. College, Amalapuram and B.L. Degree from Andhra University, Waltair. Enrolled as an Advocate of A.P. High Court on 6th February, 1976 at Hyderabad. Did his Apprentice in the Office of Sri Alladi Kuppu Swamy, Former Chief Justice, High Court of A.P. and was attached to him as a junior. After elevation of Sri Alladi Kuppu Swamy, worked in Chambers of Sri P. Siva Shanker, former Judge, High Court of A.P., former Governor & Union Minister. Started independent practice from 1974 exclusively in the High Court; attracted a fair Volume of Work in all the branches of Law, Constitutional, Civil, Criminal, Labour and Company Matters. He is an Income Tax Assessee since 1980. He was the a Legal Advisor, A.P.S.F.C. since June, 1992, b Member, A.P. High Court. Legal Aid Committee since August, 1992, c Administrator & Official Trustee of A.P. (1982-1983), d Legal Advisor, A.P.S.S.I.D.C. (1975-83), e Member, Regional Direct Taxes Advisory Committee, Hyderabad. (1983-85), f Member, Telephone Advisory Committee, Hyderabad Telecommunications (1986-88), g Member, Disciplinary Committee, Bar Council of A.P. (1978-83), h General Secretary, A.P.H.C. Advocates Association for 2 Terms (1976-77 & 1977-78), i Founder President, A.P. Young Advocates Association (1970-75) and instrumental in improving their working conditions in the Profession, j President, A.P.B.C., S.C. & S.T. Advocates Association and instrumental in implementing rule of reservation in appointment to the post of Law Officers in the State of A.P. k Associated with various Social and Cultural Organisations both at the State level and in the Twin Cities, l Actively involved in the improvement of living conditions of weaker sections, m Talented Actor and Director in Social Dramas. Name: SRI JUSTICE B.SESHASAYANA REDDY
Biodata: Born on 1.7.1951 in Tangutur, Banaganapally Village, Kurnool District and had School Education in Zilla Parishad High School, Banaganapally, Kurnool District. College, Narasaraopet Guntur District and obtained Law Degree from Andhra University in the year 1976 and LL.M from Kakatiya University, Warangal in the year 2006. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on the afternoon of 30.06.2013.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE B.SUBHASHAN REDDY
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice B. Subhashan Reddy was born on 2nd March 1943 in a Philanthrophic Bollampalli family of Bagh Amberpet in Hyderabad Urban Taluk of Andhra Pradesh, India.His School education was at the Sultan Bazar and Chadarghat High Schools, Hyderabad and college education at New Science College and degree in Science from Osmania University College of Science. He studied Law at the University College of Law, Osmania University and was enrolled as Advocate on 10 January, 1966. During the High School days and also while he was studying in the Colleges, Justice Reddy was taking keen interest in games and sports. He was particularly proficient in Foot ball and Hockey., As an Advocate Justice Reddy has been commanding extensive practise covering all branches of Law: Constitutional, Civil, Criminal, revenue, Taxation etc., and has appeared before all forums: the Supreme Court of India, the High Court, Civil and Criminal Courts, Tenancy Tribunals etc., both on the original and appellate sides.Justice Subhashan Reddy is well-read and is an eminent Advocate with outstanding merit. He is one of the leading legal practitioners in the State of Andhra Pradesh., His father, Sri B. Aga Reddy, is known for his honesty and sincerity and rendered distinguished service as Examiner of the Accounts Jagir Administration in the erstwhile State of Hyderabad.Justice Subhashan Reddy is interested in Music and Literature ancient and modern. He likes Poetry of Sri Sri. He is having collections of recordings of the veterans of the past, like K.L. Saigal and Pankaj Kumar Mallik of North and Ghantasala of South., Elevated as Judge of Andhra Pradesh High Court on 25th November, 1991. He was transferred to Tamil Nadu High Court on 11th September, 2001.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE B.SUDERSHAN REDDY
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice B. Sudershan Reddy was born on 8th July, 1946 at Akula Mylaram Village, erstwhile Ibrahimpatnam Taluq, presently Kandukur Revenue Mandal, Rangareddy District of Andhra Pradesh, India in an agricultural family.Studied in Hyderabad and obtained Law degree from Osmania University, Hyderabad in the year 1971 and enrolled as an Advocate in 1971 itself. Thereafter joined the Chambers of Shri K. Pratap Reddy, Senior Advocate., Dealt with various types of cases in City Civil Courts at Hyderabad as well as in High Court of Andhra Pradesh. Appointed as Government Pleader on 8th August, 1988 in High Court of Andhra Pradesh, In-charge of Revenue Department and continued up to 8th January, 1990. Education Society.Elected as President, Andhra Pradesh High Court Advocates Association for the year 1993-94.Appointed as Legal Advisor and Standing Counsel for Osmania University, Hyderabad on 8th January, 1993. Appointed as Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh w.e.f. 2nd May, 1995. Appointed as Chief Justice for Gauhati High Court., His Lordship relinquished the office as Judge of this High Court on the forenoon of 05-12-2005.

Name: SRI JUSTICE B.VIJAYSEN REDDY
Biodata: Born on 22.08.1970 at Hyderabad. His father Justice B. Subhashan Reddy Late was a former Chief Justice of Madras and Kerala High Courts and was also former Chairperson of A.P. State Human Rights Commission and former Lokayukta for the States of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. His grand father Sri B. Aga Reddy Late was renowned personality and was a former Examiner of Accounts Jagir Administration in the erstwhile Hyderabad State. He passed LL.B., from Padala Rama Reddy Law College (Osmania University) Hyderabad in 1994. He enrolled as an Advocate on 28.12.1994. As an advocate Justice Reddy practiced in all branches of Law and appeared in High Court in large number of Constitutional, Civil, Revenue and Criminal matters. He practiced as a private lawyer for more than 25 years and commanded good practice in Revenue Laws, Land Ceiling, Tenancy, Land Acquisition Laws, other local laws and also on civil and criminal original side and appellate side and appeared regularly in Hyderabad City and Ranga Reddy District civil, Revenue and criminal Courts. He also appeared for several religious, charitable and social organizations. He has number of reported cases to his credit. He was elevated as a permanent Judge of the High Court for the State of Telangana and assumed charge on 02.05.2020. He delivered lectures on Record of Rights and Comparative Study of Old and New Land Acquisition Acts (Young Lawyers Association, A.P. High Court), Litigation Practice, Land Reforms, Civil Procedure Code (NALSAR University), Working of Constitution (Ranga Reddy District Bar Assocation).

Name: Sri Justice Battu Devanand
Biodata: Born on 14-04-1966 at Gudivada Town, Krishna District, Andhra Pradesh to Sri Battu Venkataratnam and Smt. Manoranjitham, who were Govt. Teachers. Had his Primary School education at Panchayat Elementary School, Jami Dintakuru village, Pedaparipudi Mandal and High School education at Municipal Schools, Gudivada. Passed Intermediate and B.A., from A.N.R. College, Gudivada. Students Union President of A.N.R. College, Gudivada during 1984-85. Obtained B.L. Degree from College of Law, Andhra University, Visakhapatnam. Students Union President of Andhra University Law College during 1988-89. After enrolment as an Advocate on the rolls of Bar Council of the State of Andhra Pradesh on 06-07-1989, initially, started practice at District Courts, Visakhapatnam and joined in the office of Sri M.K. Sitaramayya, Senior Advocate, Visakhapatnam and later, shifted his practice to High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad. Served as Asst. Government Pleader in the High Court from 1996 to 2000. Counsel for various Central Government undertakings i.e., BSNL, New India Assurance Co., Oriental Insurance Co., United India Insurance Co., S.B.H., and N.T.P.C. and handled hundreds of cases as their Counsel. Handled number of cases on behalf of Poor & Vulnerable persons while doing private practice. Elected as Member of the Bar Council of the State of Andhra Pradesh in 2006. Member of the Disciplinary Committee of the Bar Council and Member of the A.P. Advocates Welfare Fund Committee during 2006-2012. Served as Government Pleader in the High Court since 14-07-2014 to 05-07-2019. Handled cases of Transport Dept., R & B Dept., Higher & Technical Education Dept., Excise Dept., Medical, Health & Family Welfare Dept., Energy, Science & Technology Dept., Forest, Fisheries, Tourism, Sports & Youth Services Departments as Government Pleader. Married to Ms Karra Padma Kumari and blessed with two daughters i.e., Ms Mouni Battu and Ms Keerthi Battu. Elevated to the Bench as Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge on 13.01.2020.

Name: SRI JUSTICE BILAL NAZKI
Biodata: Born on 18th November, 1947 at Srinagar, State of Jammu and Kashmir, India. Obtained Law Degree from Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh in 1973 and joined Bar at Srinagar. Practised in the High Court as well as in the Subordinate Courts on original and appellate side. Also appeared before the Honourable Supreme Court. Worked as the Legal Advisor to various State Government undertakings. Served as Lecturer in faculty of Law in the Kashmir University for some time. Became Deputy Advocate General of Jammu and Kashmir State in 1986 for some time and was also Advocate General of the State of Jammu and Kashmir from January, 1992 and remained as such till elevated as an Additional Judge of the Jammu & Kashmir High Court on 6th January, 1995. Was also a member of Delimitation Commission constituted under Jammu & Kashmir Representation of Peoples Act for the purpose of delimiting Assembly Constituencies in Jammu & Kashmir. Became Permanent Judge of that Court with effect from 11th December, 1995. Was transferred to Andhra Pradesh High Court where assumed office on 15th October, 1997. Worked as President of Andhra Pradesh State Judicial Academy on two occasions and also Chairman of Andhra Pradesh High Court Legal Services Committee. Was Acting Chief Justice of A.P. High Court twice from 4th April, 2005 till 26th November, 2005 and 12th November, 2007 to 6th January, 2008 and Chancellor of National Academy of Legal Studies & Research University NALSAR during this period. Was Enquiry Judge of Coal Mine Accidents twice. Was the Executive Chairman of Andhra Pradesh State Legal Services Authority., Relinquished the office of Judge ACJ on his Lordship's transfer as Judge of Bombay High Court on the forenoon of 07.01.2008.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE BILAL NAZKI
Biodata: Born on 18th November, 1947 at Srinagar, State of Jammu and Kashmir, India. Obtained Law Degree from Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh in 1973 and joined Bar at Srinagar. Practised in the High Court as well as in the Subordinate Courts on original and appellate side. Also appeared before the Honourable Supreme Court. Worked as the Legal Advisor to various State Government undertakings. Served as Lecturer in faculty of Law in the Kashmir University for some time. Became Deputy Advocate General of Jammu and Kashmir State in 1986 for some time and was also Advocate General of the State of Jammu and Kashmir from January, 1992 and remained as such till elevated as an Additional Judge of the Jammu & Kashmir High Court on 6th January, 1995. Was also a member of Delimitation Commission constituted under Jammu & Kashmir Representation of Peoples Act for the purpose of delimiting Assembly Constituencies in Jammu & Kashmir. Became Permanent Judge of that Court with effect from 11th December, 1995. Was transferred to Andhra Pradesh High Court where assumed office on 15th October, 1997. Worked as President of Andhra Pradesh State Judicial Academy on two occasions and also Chairman of Andhra Pradesh High Court Legal Services Committee. Was Acting Chief Justice of A.P. High Court twice from 4th April, 2005 till 26th November, 2005 and 12th November, 2007 to 6th January, 2008 and Chancellor of National Academy of Legal Studies & Research University NALSAR during this period. Was Enquiry Judge of Coal Mine Accidents twice. Was the Executive Chairman of Andhra Pradesh State Legal Services Authority., Relinquished the office of Judge ACJ on his Lordship's transfer as Judge of Bombay High Court on the forenoon of 07.01.2008.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE CH.S.R.K.PRASAD
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Ch. S.R.K. Prasad was born on 2nd January, 1943 in an agricultural family at Tenali, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh, India. Son of late Mr. Sivaramaiah Chowdary, a leading practitioner and Ex.Bar Council Member and President of Bar Association. He had his school education at Municipal Boys High School, Tenali. And did his Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) Degree from Loyala College, Vijayawada, Andhra University in the year 1960. Obtained B.L. degree from Andhra University in the year 1963. He did apprenticeship under the guidance of Sri D. Narasa Raju, former Advocate General. Enrolled as an Advocate on 29.5.1964, practised on Civil and Criminal side at Tenali. Entered into State Subordinate Judiciary and appointed as District Munsif on 9.11.1973. Promoted as Subordinate Judge on 24.10.1980. Promoted as District Judge Grade – II on 30.5.1987. Worked as III Addl. District Judge, Thirupathi and also as Chairman-cum-Presiding Officer, Labour Court II at Hyderabad and other places. Promoted as Grade-I District Judge on 22.7.1996. Interested in planting trees and writing Telugu poetry. Worked as Principal District and Sessions Judge at Ananthapur, Nalgonda and Visakhapatnam. Elevated to the Bench as an Additional Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 13.12.2001. Sworn in as Judge of High Court of A.P. w.e.f. 6.3.2003. He was retired on 02.01.2005 FN.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE CHALLA KODANDA RAM
Biodata: Monday, January 17,2022, Born in 1959 at Challavaripalli Village, Tadipatri Taluq, Anantapur District. Had School Education at Challavaripalli and Tadipatri. Graduated in Science from Satyasai College, White Fields, Bangalore. Obtained Law Degree from University Law College (Night College) Andhra University, Visakhapatnam in the year 1983. During 1979 to 1988 worked in an Industrial concern and was involved in execution of Civil and Mechanical works. Enrolled as an Advocate on 24.06.1988 in the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh. Was trained by Sri A. Venkata Ramana, Senior Advocate and Government Pleader and later by Sri S. Parvatha Rao (who became Judge of High Court of A.P) who was then expert in the fields of Company Law, Direct and Indirect Taxes and Constitutional matters. Designated as a Senior Advocate in the year 2009 by the High Court of A.P. Argued large number of matters like Writ Petitions, Appeals, Criminal Petitions and Tax Matters. Had also appeared in large number of cases in various Forums such as Electricity Regulatory Commissions, A.P.T.E.L., C.E.S.T.A.T, etc. Had argued in High Courts of Chhattisgarh, Delhi, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu besides Supreme Court of India. There are about 250 reported cases in various journals. Elevated as an Additional Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 12.04.2013. Married to Smt. C.Padmavathi and blessed with a daughter Shanmukha Bharathi. Appointed as Judge of the High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on 08.09.2014. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on the afternoon of 31-07-2021.]

Biodata: Hails from Parvathipuram in Vizianagaram District. Born on 21st May, 1964 in a traditional agricultural family to Cheekati Narahari Rao and Smt. Vijaya Lakshmi at Visakhapatnam. Had Elementary and High School education in R.C.M. School at Parvathipuram and St. Aloysius High School in Visakhapatnam. Studied Intermediate in Government Junior College, Parvathipuram and completed Degree in S.V. Degree College, Parvathipuram. Studied Law in M.V.P. Law College, Vizag. Enrolled as an Advocate in July, 1988 in the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh. Joined Parvathipuram Bar Association in August, 1988. Practised as an Advocate in Parvathipuram and Vizianagaram from 1988 to 2002 for 14 years. He is the third generation lawyer in the hierarchy of the family. His grandfather late Cheekati Parasuram Naidu was a reputed Advocate, Statesman and a dynamic political leader. Learnt basics in Law from his junior paternal uncle Sri Ch.B.G. Tilak Roy. After practising for 14 years, selected as District and Sessions Judge (Grade-II) in State Higher Judicial Service in the year 2002. After undergoing training in Andhra Pradesh Judicial Academy, worked as I Additional District Judge, Anantapur; VI, V and IV Additional District Judges, Visakhapatnam; Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Hyderabad; II and I Additional District Judges and Principal District Judge, Visakhapatnam; Principal District Judge, Krishna at Machilipatnam and Chairman, Andhra Pradesh VAT Tribunal, Visakhapatnam. Worked as Registrar General of High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh from 03-7-2015 to 31-12-2018. After establishment of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh, at Amaravati,he is the first Registrar General of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh from 01-01-2019 till his elevation as a Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 20-6-2019. Interested in sports, particularly in Cricket. Married to Smt. Lakshmi and the couple is blessed with two daughters Kum. Cheekati Anisha Naidu and Kum. Cheekati Reshma Sai. Appointed as a Permanent Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh, at Amaravati on 12-6-2019. First Judge to be appointed after constitution of High Court of Andhra Pradesh w.e.f. 01-01-2019.

Name: SRI JUSTICE D.S.R.VARMA
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice D.S.R. Varma was born on 5th September 1949 at Narsapur in West Godavari District of Andhra Pradesh, India. Justice Dantuluri Srinivasa Ranganadha Varma is the son of Late Sri D. Jagapathi Raju, an Advocate. His mother was a Hindi Teacher in Mission High School, Narsapur. Obtained degree of Bachelor of Arts from Sri Y.N. College, Narsapur and Bachelor of Laws from the Andhra University, Visakhapatnam and LL.M from Acharya Nagarjuna University, Guntur. Enrolled as an Advocate on August 20, 1974 and initially joined his father's office at Narsapur. Later on, shifted his practice to the High Court of Andhra Pradesh from June, 1975 and joined the Chambers of Sri Krovidi Narasimham, a leading Lawyer. Specialised in Labour Laws, Co-operative Laws and gained sufficient experience in Civil as well as Criminal matters. Nominated as a Panel Advocate for State Bank of Hyderabad and represented Insurance Companies selectively. Appointed as Standing Counsel for A.P.S.R.T.C. during the year 1992-93 and also the Standing Counsel for Central Silk Board, a Central Government undertaking. Appointed as Government Pleader representing Revenue Department in A.P. administrative Tribunal in the month of January, 1996 and continued as such till he was transferred and appointed as Government Pleader in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh and was dealing with matters pertaining to Land Grabbing and Land Assignment., Appointed as Additional Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh on May 17, 1999 and as Judge w.e.f.20.4.2000.Since his college days Justice D.S.R. Varma showed keen interest in sports particularly Tennis and Shuttle Badminton. Transferred as Judge of Allahabad High Court w.e.f. 28.10.2010. Transferred as Judge of Allahabad High Court and relinquished the charge of office on 27.10.2010 A.N.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE D.SESHADRI NAIDU
Biodata: Born on 19th June, 1962 to late Sri D. Narayanaswamy Naidu and late Smt. Lakshmamma at Ganganagunta, a hamlet away from Tirupathi, the holy pilgrim town., Did his graduation from Andhra University, Visakhapatnam; later he obtained Law Degree from Sri Venkateswara University, Tirupathi; thereafter he got enrolled as a member on the roles of Bar Counsel of Andhra Pradesh in March, 1997. To gain trial court experience, initially he established his practise in Tirupathi, and practiced in both branches of law – civil & criminal. Later, having shifted practise in early 2000’s to Hyderabad, he started practice in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh, as well as the Civil and Criminal Courts in the city. Represented many corporate entities and nationalised banks, apart from private clientele, picking up practice in all branches of Law., He got himself associated with AP Judicial Academy, Hyderabad, as a guest faculty and taught various subjects, notably Hindu Succession Act, 1956 and Negotiable Instrument Act, 1881. He authored a few law books, such as the Law of Stamp Duty & Registration in Andhra Pradesh and the Andhra Pradesh Education Code, etc., He has fascination for literature – Telugu & English, has the enduring habit of listening to radio, and an ear for music., His Lordship Sri Justice Dama Seshadri Naidu was elevated as Additional Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 21st September, 2013. Transferred as an additional Judge of the Kerala High Court and assumed charge of office on the forenoon of 30.06.2014.]

Name: Sri Justice D.V.S.S.Somayajulu
Court: High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh
Biodata: He was born on 26.09.1961 in a family of lawyers. He is a 4th generation lawyer. His father, late Sri D.V.Subba Rao, was the third generation of a family of distinguished lawyers and a leading Advocate of repute at Visakhapatnam in the State of Andhra Pradesh, holding positions as Chairman, Bar Council of India, Mayor of Visakhapatnam, President, Andhra Cricket Association etc. He had his early education at Visakhapatnam. He did his B.Com., at Dr.L.B. College, Visakhapatnam, and B.L., from Andhra University, Visakhapatnam. He was enrolled as an Advocate on the Roll of Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh and practiced law at Visakhapatnam. He had extensively practised before various mofussil courts and dealt with all kinds of cases with specialization in civil, commercial and arbitration matters. He had appeared before erudite legal luminaries of national and international eminence in arbitrations all over India and abroad also. He was counsel for numerous Public Sector Undertakings and for a number of private companies and banks besides having a large private clientele. He was the President of the Andhra Cricket Association, Member of the Legal Committee of the Board of Cricket Control BCCI, President of Bar Association, Visakhapatnam, The Waltair Club, Visakhapatnam, and General Trustee to the Visakha Music and Dance Academy, Mrs.AVN College, & Public Library, Visakhapatnam. He was nominated as ‘Swatchh Bharat Ambassador’ for Visakhapatnam. He was appointed as Judge of the High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and sworn-in on 21.09.2017. He is the first Advocate from a mofussil Bar in Andhra Pradesh who is directly elevated as a Judge of a High Court.

Name: SRI JUSTICE DALAVA SUBRAHMANYAM
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Dalava Subrahmanyam was born on 1.7.1942 at Puttur, Chittoor District of Andhra Pradesh, India. He did his Secondary Education at Puttur and Graduated from Loyola College, Madras and took his B.A., Degree in the year 1962. He was a student of Madras Law College and took his B.L., degree in the year 1964 from Madras University. He joined as an apprentice in the Office of Sri K.K. Venugopal, Advocate, Madras, now Senior Counsel of Supreme Court. He enrolled as an Advocate on the rolls of Bar Council of Madras, on 19.10.1964 and appeared along with him till 1966 in the High Court of Madras and later shifted his practice to Chittoor in the year 1966 and practised as an Advocate up to 1973.He was appointed as District Munsif in the year 1973 and entered into service on 9.11.1973. He worked as Munsif Magistrate from 1973 to 1980 and promoted as Subordinate Judge in the year 1980 and worked as District & sessions Judge, Grade-II since 1987 and Grade-I since 22.12.1995. He worked as Special Judge to try cases under SPE and ACB Cases at Visakhapatnam and Hyderabad and worked as Prl. District & Sessions Judge at Anantapur and Ongole. As Chairman of the District Legal Services Authority, he organised number of Legal Literacy Camps and conducted several Lok Adalats and large number of criminal cases and compensation claims under Motor Vehicles Act were settled. He worked as Metropolitan Sessions Judge and as Chief Judge, City Civil Court, Hyderabad. Elevated to the Bench of A.P. High Court as an Additional Judge on 13.12.2001. Sworn in as Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh w.e.f. 06.03.2003. He was retired on 30.06.2004.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE DEVINDER GUPTA
Biodata: Born on April 4, 1943 He did his graduation B.A. After that he did his LL.B., He Enrolled as an Advocate on March 23, 1967. He practised in the District Courts of Himachal Pradesh on Originaland Appellate side from 1967 to 1975. Thereafter, practised in Himachal Pradesh High Court, Shimla in all branches of law i.e Civil, Criminal, Constitutional, Taxation and labour, till elevation as Judge of Himachal Pradesh High Court., He was appointed as permanent Judge of Himchal Pradesh High Court on June 25, 1990 and subsequently transferred as Judge, Delhi High Court with effect from 28th April, 1994.He was appointed as Executive Chairman of Delhi State Legal Services Authority and looking after Legal Aid Movement in Delhi and holding of Lok Adalats for prompt disposal of cases., He was Acting Chief Justice, Delhi High Court on four different occasions., He sworn-in as Chief Justice, High Court of Judicature of Andhra Pradesh on 6th March, 2003. Name: SRI JUSTICE DILIP BABASAHEB BHOSALE
Biodata: Dilip Babasaheb Bhosale was born on 24th October 1956. After completing his education and obtaining a Degree of Law from Government Law College, Mumbai, he joined the Bar in June-1980. Since then he was practicing in the Bombay High Court at Mumbai till his elevation as Judge of that Court on 22nd January, 2001. He was then transferred to Karnataka High Court on 6th January, 2012 and then to this High Court vide notification dated 1st December, 2014. He assumed the charge as a Senior-most Judge of this High Court on 8th December, 2014., 2. He was Assistant Government Pleader and Assistant Prosecutor in the High Court at Mumbai during 1986-1991. He was appointed on the panel of Senior Counsel in the Bombay High Court by the Government of India in 1996. He was also appointed as a Special Counsel in the High Court by the Government of Maharashtra in 1998. He represented the Government of India and the Government of Maharashtra as Special Counsel in several important cases. He also represented Maharashtra State Farming Corporation, Maharashtra State Finance Corporation, Maharashtra State Marketing Federation, Maharashtra State Cotton Grower Federation in the Bombay High Court. He was also Standing Counsel for number of educational institutions, sugar factories, District Central Co-operative Banks, Municipal Corporations, Municipal Councils, various Co-operative Societies and Trusts., 3. During his practicing days, he enjoyed three consecutive terms of five (5) years each as an elected member of the Bar Council of Maharashtra and Goa since 1985 till his elevation as High Court Judge. During this period, he was elected as Vice-Chairman in 1987-88 and Chairman in 1993-94 of the State Bar Council. In April 1998 he was elected as a member of the Bar Council of India, representing the State of Maharashtra and Goa and became its Vice-Chairman in April 2000, for a period of two years. He was also President of one of the most prestigious and old Bar Associations of Bombay High Court, namely, “Advocates Association of Western India” for a period of two years (1997-1998 and 1998-1999). He was member of the Legal Education Committee for 3 years (1998-2000) constituted under the Advocates Act. He was also member of the General Council, National Law School, Bangalore since 1998 for about 12 years. He was a Trustee of one of the oldest Law Libraries in the Bombay High Court, namely “Kirtikar Law Library” between 1992-2001. He has been an elected member of the Governing Council from Judges Constituency of Indian Law Institute, New Delhi since 2006. He had the honour to be a member of the delegation representing Lawyers in India in the Common-Wealth Lawyers Conference held in September-1999 at Kaulalampur, Malaysia. He was also entrusted with the responsibility of attending the Bar Leaders Conference organized by the International Bar Association held on 15th and 16th September, 2000, representing the Lawyers in India. He also led the delegation of Indian Lawyers to the International Lawyers Conference of I.B.A in 2000., 4. He comes from a family of Freedom Fighters. His parents and maternal grandparents were freedom fighters. His father Barrister Babasaheb Bhosale was Chief Minister of the State of Maharashtra. His uncle Prof.Shivajirao Bhosale was Vice-Chancellor of Marathwada University, Maharashtra. His all family members are settled in Mumbai. He was married to Smt. Arundhati on 26th April, 1982 and blessed with son-Karan and daughter-Neha. Both are married and settled in Mumbai. , 5. Nominated as the Executive Chairman of the Andhra Pradesh State Legal Services Authority, Hyderabad w.e.f. the forenoon of 02.01.2015., 6. Appointed to perform the duties of the office of the Chief Justice of High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of the Andhra Pradesh w.e.f 07.05.2015 FN. , 7. Appointed as the Chief Justice of Allahabad High Court and Sworn-in as such on the forenoon of 30-07-2016.]

Name: Sri Justice Donadi Ramesh
Biodata: He was born on 27.6.1965 at Kammapalli village, near Madanapalli, Chittoor District. His father late Sri D.V.Narayana Naidu, was a retired Engineer in Panchayat Raj Department and his mother late Smt. Annapurnamma was a house wife. He did his graduation from Sri Venkateswara Arts College, Tirupathi, Chittoor District. He did his Bachelor of law from V.R.Law College, Nellore in the year 1987-90. He was enrolled as an Advocate in Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh in the year 1990. After enrollment, he started practice at Andhra Pradesh High Court, Hyderabad and joined in the office of Sri Justice P.S.Narayana. During his practice at Andhra Pradesh High Court, Hyderabad he was appointed as Government Pleader for Services and worked from December 2000 to 2004. After that he was appointed as Standing Counsel for A.P.Sarvasiksha Abhiyaan in the year 2007 and worked till 2013. Appointed as Special Government Pleader attached to the Office of Advocate General in the year 2014 and worked till May 2019. Elevated to the Bench as Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge on 13.01.2020.

Name: SRI JUSTICE E. VENKATESAM
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice E. Venkatesam was born on 9th May, 1908. Educated at C.B.M. High School and Mrs. A.V.N. college, Vizagapatam, Maharajah's college, Vizianagaram and Law College, Madras. Enrolled as an Advocate of Madras High Court in September, 1936 practised in the Courts of Vizagapatnam District from 1930-1942, Madras High Court from 1942 to 1954. High Court of Andhra at Guntur from 1954 to 1956 and High Court of Andhra Pradesh from 1956 to 1961. Worked as Member, Board of Examiners and part-time lecturer in Law College, Madras from 1942 to 1950. Edited Andhra Weekly Reporter. Appointed as an Additional Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh from 16th November, 1961. Permanent Judge from 12th February, 1964. retired on 9th May, 1970.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE E.DHARMA RAO
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice E. Dharma Rao was born on 15th July 1951 in an agricultural family of Krapa village situated in Mummadivaram Mandal, east Godavari District of Andhra Pradesh, India to his late parents Sri E. Suranna and Smt. E. Neelama. He passed his S.S.L.C. in 1969 from Zilla Parishad High School, Ananthavaram. He joined in P.U.C. in S.K.B.R. College, Amalapuram and passed in the year 1970, thereafter obtained Bachelor's degree in Arts in 1973 from the same College. He did his Master's Degree in Sociology in 1973-75 from Andhra University, Waltair. Thereafter, he took his Bachelor's Degree in Law in 1978 from the same University. Thereafter he enrolled himself as an Advocate on 2.11.1978 at A.P. State Bar Council, Hyderabad and joined the Chambers of Mr. M.R.K. Choudhary and continued for about 4 years. Thereafter, in 1982 he was selected as a Trainee under the Scheme of Administration of Justice, sponsored by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh and joined the office of Advocate General. In 1983 he was appointed as Assistant Government Pleader and associated with four Advocate Generals up to 1989: Sri K. Subrahmanya Reddy, Sri E. Manohar, Sri V.Venataramaiah and Sri R. Venugopal Reddy. In 1990 he was appointed as Government Pleader and dealt with the subjects of Irrigation, Housing and Municipal Administration for a period of one year. Besides that, he was also Standing Counsel for Andhra University from 1989 to 1993 and Standing Counsel for Food Corporation of India and also Panel Advocate for United India Insurance Company Limited and New India Assurance Company Limited. He was also Standing Counsel for Municipal Corporation of Hyderabad, during the period from 1992 to 1995. Name: SRI JUSTICE G. CHANDR. IAH
Biodata: Born in an agriculturist family on 10.05.1954 in Timmapur village, Jannaram Mandal, Adilabad District to Sri Gunda Beerpuri and Smt. Marthamma. He completed primary education, 1st to 3rd class at his native village and primary school at Timmapur. He completed the upper primary and secondary education i.e., 4th to S.S.C., from Z.P.H.S., Tapalapur. He completed intermediate and graduation i.e., B.A. at Government Arts and Science College, Adilabad. He completed LL.B., M.A. (Political Science) and LL.M. from Osmania University, Hyderabad., Enrolled as an Advocate on the rolls of Bar Council of A.P. on 6.11.1980 and joined the chambers of Sri I.Venkatanarayana, who was later elevated to the Bench of A.P. High Court and now functioning as Chairman of A.P. State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Hyderabad. On 8.4.1983, he was selected for undergoing training for a period of three years in Administration of justice sponsored by the Social Welfare Department, Government of A.P. and was allotted to the office of the then Government Pleader for Education, High Court of A.P., Sri Syed Shah Mohammed Quadri, who was later elevated as Judge of A.P. High Court, functioned as the Acting Chief Justice, was later elevated as Judge of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India and who functioned as Chairman of Authority for Advance Rulings (Central Excise and Customs), New Delhi., He functioned as Government Pleader during (1991–95) and 1999 to November, 2002 and dealt with cases relating to the Department of Social Welfare, Panchayat Raj & Rural Development; Finance and Planning, Labour, Employment and Training; Prohibition and Excise. During his tenure as G.P. for 2nd term, he dealt with the cases relating to Act 2/94 and F & P (FW PC III) Department, dated 22.4.1994 etc., relating to the regularization to services of NMRs etc. While functioning as G.P. for Prohibition and Excise, he assisted the Hon'ble Court in rendering remarkable decisions, including Full Bench Judgement relating to ‘Black Jaggery’ reported in 2002 I ALT 611 (F.B.), based on which recently A.P. Excise Act, 1968 was amended., He functioned as Standing Counsel for several institutions during the following periods: ( i ) A.P. Scheduled Castes Co-Op. Finance Corporation Ltd. 1987 – 91,1995 – 99, ( ii ) A.P. Social Welfare Residential Educational Institutions Society (1993 – 2003), iii A.P. Municipalities (Telangana Area) (1996 – July 1999), ( iv ) A.P. Study Circle 1998 onwards till elevation, ( v ) A.P.T.W. Residential Educational Institutions Society 1999 onwards till elevation. , He was nominated as Member of High Court Legal Services Committee for 2 terms for two years each time. He was also member of the Board of Studies in Law, Osmania University for two terms from 1999 – 2002. He was a member of Legal Services Authority before his elevation as Additional Judge of A.P. High Court. , He sworn in as Additional Judge of A.P. High Court on 26.05.2005. Appointed as a Permanent Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court on 20-02-2006 F.N., Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on the afternoon of 09.05.2016.]
Other_Bachelors_Institution: Government Arts and Science College, Adilabad

Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice G. Chandrasekhara Sastry was born on 7th May, 1905. Name: SRI JUSTICE G.BHAVANI PRASAD
Biodata: He is the grand son of Grandhi Venkata Reddy Naidu, Former Minister for Law, Courts, Prisons and Endowments in the first Cabinet of State of Andhra Pradesh and son of Grandhi Kesava Rama Murthy, a leading Advocate for 54 years at Narasapur, West Godavari, District., He was born on 09-04-1951 and had his education at Narasapur, Andhra Loyola College, Vijayawada and Andhra University, Waltair. He won the Andhra University Law College Decennial Celebration Prize in 1969 for securing the highest number of marks., He was enrolled as Advocate on 10-04-1972 and practised at Narasapur. He joined the State Judicial Service as a direct recruit District Munsif on 16-08-1976. He worked as Munsif Magistrate at Chirala, Razole, Repalle, Amalapuram, Sirpur and Hyderabad., He was promoted as a Subordinate Judge on 22-02-1986 and worked at Suryapet and Hyderabad. He was Assistant Director, Law, A.P. Police Academy for two years., On promotion as District Judge on 13-03-1992, he worked as Additional Chief Judge, City Civil Court-cum-II Additional Special Judge for SPE and ACB Cases, Hyderabad. He was Additional Director, A.P.Judicial Academy for three and half years and Law Secretary to the State Government for five and half years. He worked as Principal District and Sessions Judge, Chittoor for three years and then as Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Hyderabad and Member Secretary, A.P.State Legal Services Authority. He worked as Registrar General, High Court of Andhra Pradesh from 26-05-2005. He was a Super-time Scale District Judge., He was sworn in as an Additional Judge of Andhra Pradesh High Court on 04-01-2006 forenoon. He was appointed as permanent Judge, High Court of Andhra Pradesh with effect from 19-12-2007 forenoon., He participated in a six week programme on Gender and Law at the University of Warwick, United Kingdom in 1996 on being nominated by the Supreme Court. He also participated in the International Visitor Programme on U.S.Judiciary and Rule of Law in 1998 on the invitation of the U.S.A. Government. He participated in a Thirty-Four Country International Conference on Legal Systems and Reforms Organised by the University of California at Berkely in June, 1998. He delivered a public lecture on “Building Legal Systems in Newly Emerging Nations: Focus on Andhra Pradesh State in India” at Cleveland State University, Ohio, U.S.A. in an event co-sponsored by Cleveland-Marshall College of Law, Maxine Goodman Levin College of Urban Affairs and Nance College of Business Administration, on 04-05-2006. He was one of the founder members of the National Academy of Legal Studies & Research University, Hyderabad and Regional Centre of ICADR at Hyderabad. He was involved in drafting about 250 State Legislations as Law Secretary. He was Guest Faculty for various training programmes at Andhra Pradesh Judicial Academy, Dr. MCR HRD Institute, A.P. Police Academy and S.V.P. National Police Academy, Hyderabad. He retired on attaining the age of Superannuation on the afternoon of 08-04-2013. He was a Member of the Executive Council and General Council of Damodaram Sanjivayya National Law University, Visakhapatnam. He is a Life Member of Indian Council of Arbitration ICA, New Delhi and the International Centre for Alternative Dispute Resolution ICADR, New Delhi and is in the Panels of Arbitrators of ICA and ICADR. He was also the Chairman of the Institutional Ethics Committee of FACTS (Fraternity of Advanced Cardiovascular Techniques and Solutions) Foundation, Hyderabad. He is designated as a Senior Advocate by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India with effect from 03-09-2013., He is appointed as the Chairman of the Andhra Pradesh State Electricity Regulatory Commission with effect from 11-10-2014.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE G.BIKSHAPATHY
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice G. Bikshapathy was born on 3rd May 1943 at Karmanghat village formerly in Hyderabad District of Andhra Pradesh, India. After passing Matriculation he completed Diploma in Commerce in 1962. Thereafter, he entered the Government Service and worked for 13 years in various departments. While in Government service he prosecuted further studies in Evening College. He passed B.Com., and thereafter he joined Evening Law College. After passing LL.B. obtained Master Degree in Labour Laws. Joined Advocate profession in June 1975. He extensively dealt with Labour and Service matters. Number of cases in which he appeared have been reported in All India Journals. He is ardent supporter of cause of weaker sections. Member of Lions club. He conducted cases on behalf of number of Trade Unions both State and National level. He was legal Advisor to number of Government and Private undertakings. He was a government Pleader in the High Court for a short spell. He is Member of International Jurists Organisation and World Jurists Organisation. He participated in International conferences and Labour Laws conducted by the Law Asia and International Jurists Organisation. Delivered Lectures at the Administrative Staff College of India to the participants in Trade Union field. Organised Seminars on the subjects on national and international importance., He was elevated to the Constitutional Post as Judge of A.P. High Court on 2nd May 1995. Delivered number of important judgments on constitutional and Service matters which are reported in All India Journals. He also attended Rajayoga meditation programme for one week at Mt. Abu conducted by Brahma Kumaris’ Institution. Appointed as an Additional Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court on 2.5.1995 and Judge w.e.f.16.01.1997. His Lordship retired from the service on attaining the age of Superannuation w.e.f. 03-05-2005.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE G.S.SINGHVI
Biodata: Born at Jodhpur on 12-12-1948 and son of Mr.M.M.Singhvi. Graduated in Science in the year 1968 from Jodhpur University and passed LL.B. Examination in the year 1971 with Gold Medal from Rajasthan University., Joined the legal profession on 28-07-1971 under Shri Marudhar Mridul. Practiced in Rajasthan High Court of Jodhpur till June, 1977 and shifted to Jaipur upon creation of High Court Bench at Jaipur. He was elevated to the Bench of Rajasthan High Court as Judge on 20-07-1990. He was transferred to Punjab and Haryana High Court on 28-04-1994. He was transferred as Judge of the Gujarat High Court on 28-02-2005. , He was sworn in as the Chief Justice of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 27-11-2005. Appointed as Judge, Supreme Court of India and assumed charge as such on the forenoon of 12-11-2007.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE G.SHYAM PRASAD
Court: High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh
Biodata: Born on 27th September, 1958, at Guntur to Sri late G.Mallikharjuna Rao and Smt. G.Savitramma. Had school education in Sri Pulipaka Kamala Hanumantaraya High School, Guntur. Did his graduation in Commerce from Hindu College, Guntur. Studied law degree in V.R. Law College, Nellore. Enrolled as a member on the rolls of the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh and started practice at Guntur. Was attached to the office of Sri N.Chalapati Rao, the then Government Pleader, Guntur. Joined in judicial service as District Munsif on 07-10-1985 and worked as such at Vijayawada and Madhira. Promoted as Senior Civil Judge and worked as such at Hyderabad, Nizamabad, Kavali and Suryapet. On further promotion, served as II Additional District Judge, Karimnagar; I Additional District Judge, Anantapur; II Additional District Judge, Hindupur; I Additional District Judge, Anantapur; II Additional District Judge, Visakhapatnam; Chairman & Presiding Officer, Industrial Tribunal – cum – Labour Court, Visakhapatnam; III Additional District Judge, Tirupati; I Additional District Judge, Tirupati; Presiding Officer, S.T.A.T., Hyderabad; Principal District Judge, Medak at Sangareddy; Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Nampally, Hyderabad; and Member Secretary, A.P. State Legal Services Authority, Hyderabad, till his elevation as Judge, High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and sworn in as such and assumed charge on the forenoon of 20-05-2016. Laid down office on 26.09.2020 on attaining the age of superannuation.

Name: SRI JUSTICE G.V.SEETHAPATHY
Biodata: Born on 22-11-1950 at Nellore. Graduated from Andhra Loyola College, Vijayawada and studied Law in Osmania University, Hyderabad. Enrolled as an Advocate in 1972 with the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh and joined the office of his father Sri G.V.Subrahmanyam, who was a leading light of Nellore Bar. Joined State Judicial Service in 1976 and worked as Munsif Magistrate and promoted as Subordinate Judge in 1987 and became member of the A.P.State Higher Judicial Service and appointed as District Judge, in the year 1992. Worked as Additional District Judge, Kurnool, Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Hyderabad, Special Judge for Economic Offences, Hyderabad, Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Hyderabad and District & Sessions Juge, Krishna at Machilipatnam. Also functioned as Additional Director, A.P. Judicial Academy., Attended the programme of training for trainers on 'Gender and Law' in U.K in 1996. On return from U.K., and as a follow-up, participated in judicial colloquia in several states, which were conducted by the National Judicial Academy in collaboration with the British Council and State Judicial Academies for training judicial officers on several aspects of gender and law., Also worked as Registrar Judicial, Registrar Vigilance and Registrar Administration, High Court of Andhra Pradesh from May 1997 to December 2002. Worked as Secretary, Law Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh., Elevated to the Bench as Additional Judge, High Court of Andhra Pradesh and was sworn in on 24-05-2006. Appointed as permanent Judge, High Court of Andhra Pradesh w.e.f. 19-12-2007 F.N. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on the afternoon of 21-11-2012.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE GHULAM MOHAMMED
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Ghulam Mohammed was born on 6th April, 1950 at Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, India. Had the primary education at Begumbazar Primary School, High School education at Goshamahal Higher Secondary School. Obtained degree in Science from Osmania University in May, 1974. Obtained LL.B. from Osmania University in October, 1976, and LL.M. in January, 1982. Enrolled as an Advocate in December, 1976 in the A.P. Bar Council and joined the office of the Hon'ble Mr. Justice Syed Shah Mohammed Quadri. Conducted cases on civil side in the trial Courts and High Court of A.P., Worked as Assistant Government Pleader from 1982 to 1990. Appointed as Government Pleader for Education, Medical, Health, Finance and Planning in A.P .Administrative Tribunal, Hyderabad on 3.2.1992. On 6.1.1995 appointed as Government Pleader for Finance and Planning, Labour, Employment and Training, Women & Child Welfare, Tourism, in the High Court of A.P. Appointed as Additional Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 17.5.1999 and as Judge w.e.f. 20.4.2000. Appointed to perform the duties of the Office of the Chief Justice, High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad from 26.10.2011 to 14.11.2011. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation ie., 62 years on 05-04-2012 A.N.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE GOPAL RAO EKBOTE
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Gopal Rao Ekbote was born on 1st June, 1912. Educated at Saraswati Bhuvan Middle School, and Government High School. Aurangabad and Osmania University. Enrolled as an Advocate of the Hyderabad High Court on 28th November 1948 and as an Advocate of Supreme Court in 1951. practiced in the beginning in the Munsif Magistrate's court in Aurangabad District, then in the Subordinate Courts and High Court at Hyderabad. Stated practising in the Andhra Pradesh High Court since the reorganisation of state. Practised mostly on Civil side. Was Minister of Education, Local Government and Parliamentary Affairs in the former Hyderabad State from 26th January, 1954 to 31st October, 1956 and also a Member f the Legislative Assembly of Andhra Pradesh for some time., Appointed as Additional Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court for a period of two years with effect from 7th June, 1962. Permanent Judge from 12th February, 1964., Appointed chief Justice of A.P. with effect from 1st April, 1972. retired on 1st June, 1974.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE H. ANANTHANARAYANN AYYAR
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice H. Ananthanarayan Ayyar was born on 24th November, 1907. Educated at St. Xaviers High School, Palamcottah, Hindu College, Tirunelvelli St. Joseph's College, Tiruchirapalli: later studied at London on University. Joined Indian Civil Service in December, 1932 and worked as Assistant and Sub Collector before his posting for Judicial Training as Additional District Munsif in July, 1941. Appointed as Additional Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh for 2 years from 21.10.1959 and reappointed as Additional Judge from 21.10.1961. Permanent Judge from 9.2.1962. Retired on 24.11.1969.]
