Name: SRI JUSTICE I.VENKATANARAYANA
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice I. Venkatanarayana was born on 2nd April 1940 at Chittoor of Andhra Pradesh, India. He had his early education at district Board High School, Chittoor and Intermediate in Pachiyappa's College, Madras University. He obtained M.A. Degree in Economics from Sri Venkateswara University, Tirupathi and did his LL.B from Delhi University. He hails from a respectable family and his father Sri Inti Muniswamy Naidu was a leading lawyer at Chittoor. He joined the High Court Bar and was associated with Sri T.Anantha Babu, Senior Advocate and present Advocate-General. He is a member of the International Law Association and he represented the association at MONTREAL CANADA in 1982 and at WASHINGTON in 1992. He is also a Member of the Governing Council of the Indian Law Institute, New Delhi and has successfully conducted two International Law Conferences on Human Rights & Child Labour. He is an Executive Member of the Indian Arbitration and Conciliation Proceedings. As a Senior Advocate he commanded large volume of work and argued number of important cases on Constitution, Company Law and Taaxation. He was a Standing Counsel for A.P. Housing Board and number of nationalised banks and companies. He was elevated as Addl. Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 17th May 1999 and as Judge w.e.f. 20th April 2000. In a short span of one year and three months he has delivered number of important judgments on civil law. Retired on 2.04.2002.]
LLB_Institutition: Faculty of Law, University of Delhi

Name: SRI JUSTICE J.CHELAMESWAR
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Jasti Chelameswar was born on June 23, 1953 at Pedda Muttevi, Movva Mandal in Krishna District at Andhra Pradesh, India. His father was late Jasti Lakshminarayana, a lawyer at Machilipatnam, Krishna District. Had his earlier education up to class XII at Hindu High School at Machilipatnam in Krishna District and Graduated in Science Physics at Madras Loyala College. Graduated in Law from Andhra University Visakhapatnam, in 1976. Enrolled as an Advocate in High Court of Andhra Pradesh at Hyderabad in the year 1976 and practised under a senior Advocate Dr. B. Bhimaraju, former Public Prosecutor, High Court of A.P., Sri P. Rajarao, Ex. Government Pleader High Court of A.P. and Sri K. Srinivasa Murthy, a leading Advocate in High Court of A.P. Specialised in Constitutional Law, Election Laws, Central Excise, Customs, Income Tax and Criminal Law. Appointed as Standing Counsel of A.P. Lokayukta in 1985 and 1986. Worked as Government Pleader for Home Affairs in High Court in the years 1988 and 1989. Designated as Senior Counsel in the year 1995. Appointed as Additional Advocate General on 13.10.1995. , Elevated as Addl. Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 23.6.1997 and as Judge w.e.f. 17.5.1999.Appointed as Chief Justice of Gauhati High Court and assumed charge as Chief Justice of Gauhati High Court on 3.5.2007]

Name: SRI JUSTICE J.R.VIMADALAL
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice J.R.Vimadalal was born on 11th March, 1915 educated at Cathedral and John Connon High School, Bhards. New High School, Elphinstone College, Government of Law College, Bombay. Enrolled as an Advocate (A.S.)., on 7-9-1936. Advocate (O.S.)., on 24-8-1939, and Advocate of Supreme Court on 7-9-1941. Appointed as Additional Judge of the High Court of Judicature at Bombay on 25th April, 1967 for a period of two years. Appointed permanent Judge on 26th October, 1967. Name: SRI JUSTICE K. PUNNAYYA
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice K. Punnayya was born on 19th August, 1923. Educated in Baruva, Surangi Rajah's High School, Ichapuram, M.R. College, Vizianagaram and Andhra University, Waltair. While studying in Intermediate M.R. College, Vizianagaram, he participated in Quit India movement in 1942 and underwent imprisonment for six months and had to discontinue studies. After attainment of Independence resumed studies in 1947. Obtained Law degree in 1953. Enrolled as an Advocate in September, 1956 and set up practice in Srikakulam. Practised both on Criminal and Civil sides and became one of the leading Advocates. In 1964 directly recruited as District and Sessions Judge Gr-II. Promoted as Grade-I District and Sessions Judge in July 1971 while working as Chief Judge, City Small Causes Court. Worked as chief Judge, City Civil Court, Hyderabad from 16th November, 1972 till he was elevated to the Bench on 17th October, 1974, as permanent Judge. Associated with public activities and educational Institutions. Elected as Member of Legislature in 1955 and re-elected in 1962 and continued to be a Member of Legislature till 1964. Was also a Senator of Andhra University for two terms. Was Vice-chairman of Srikakulam Zilla Parshad for a term. Was a Member of the State Transport Authority, Hyderabad from 1962 to 1964.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE K.LAKSHMAN
Biodata: He was born on 08.06.1966 to Sri K. Gopal and Smt. K. Sathamma, who hail from an agriculture family. Of the five children (two sons and three daughters), he is the second one and the eldest son. He belongs to Bogaram village of Ramannapet Mandal in Yadadri - Bhuvanagiri District. His school journey had taken place in Government Schools at Bogaram and Ramannapet villages respectively. He did his Graduation with B.Sc., (M.P.C.) from New Science Degree College, Ameerpet, Hyderabad, and later did his LL.B., from V.R. Law College, Nellore of Sri Venkateshwara University. After completion of Law Degree, he enrolled as an Advocate in the year 1993 with the Andhra Pradesh Bar Council and joined in the office of Sri Madiraju Radhakrishna Murthy, Advocate and did his juniorship for some time in the erstwhile High Court of Andhra Pradesh and various other Subordinate Courts in and around the twin cities and thereafter started his independent practice from 1999 on the side of Civil Law, Constitutional Law and Cooperative Laws. He was also Standing Counsel for Uranium Corporation of India and various private reputed Institutions or Companies. He got married to A. Manjula Rani. He was blessed with two daughters, Ms. Sreeja and Ms. Himaja. He was appointed as an Assistant Solicitor General of India for the High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the States of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh on 24th August, 2017, and after bifurcation of the High Court, served as such for the High Court of Telangana State and discharged his duties till his elevation as a Judge of the Honourable High Court. He has been elevated as a Judge for the High Court of State Telangana and was sworn-in as such in the forenoon of Monday, 26th of August 2019.

Name: SRI JUSTICE K.M. AGARWAL

Enrolled as an advocate in the year 1962 and practised at Rayapur District Court, from 1968 practised in the High Court at Jabalpur. Elevated as additional Judge on14.5.1984. Transferred to Andhra Pradesh High Court as Judge on 14.5.1986.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE K.MADHAVA REDDY
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice K. Madhava Reddy was born on 21.10.1923. Educated in Hyderabad in Chaderghat High School and Nizam College. Took Post-Graduate Degree, in Economics from the Ferguson College, Poona and Law Degree from the Law College, Ploona. And Law Degree from the Law College., Poona. Enrolled as an Advocate on 2.9.1944. Did Civil, Criminal, Revenue, Original and Appellate, Taxation Cases at Hyderabad. Associated Closely with Bar Association, Hyderabad and Advocates’ Association of High Court of Andhra Pradesh as a member of Executive and also as Secretary of both. Member of the Bar Council from the Beginning and also its Vice-Chairman during 1956-58 and again in 1960-64. Worked as Government Pleader from 6.6.1966 till 5.11.1967 and as Public Prosecutor from 5.11.1967 till 28.5.1968 in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh at Hyderabad., Appointed as Judge from 28.5.1968. Acted as Commission of Enquiry into Police Firing on March, 19th 1973 at Cuddapah.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE K.S. SHRIVASTAV
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice K.S. Shrivastav was born on 03.03.1938. Obtained B.A.,LL.B., started practice of Law from 27th September, 1964 at Chihindware, Madhya Pradesh. Appointed as Additional District and Sessions Judge directly from the Bar in the year 1973. Work as under secretary and Deputy Secretary in the Court of Madhya Pradesh in Law Department from 1978 to 1983. Worked as District and Sessions Judge from 1983 to 1994. Appointed as Judge of High Court of Madhya Pradesh on 27.09.1994. Transferred as a Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court on 06.10.1994. Retired on 03.03.2000.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE K.S.APPA RAO
Biodata: Born on 05-03-1951 at Rajahmundry, East Godavari District to Smt. Simhachalam & Late Sri Kolla Veeraswamy. His father was a reputed businessman in Rajahmundry known for simplicity, sincerity, integrity and generosity., Had primary education at Rajahmundry., Obtained B.Com., degree from D.R. Goenka Government College, Tadepalligudem. Obtained B.L. Degree from Andhra University Law College, Visakhapatnam. Obtained L.L.M. Degee from Osmania University, Hyderabad., Enrolled as Advocate in the year 1975. Associated as junior in the office of the reputed senior counsel Sri S.R.K.Hanumantha Rao at Rajahmundry., Joined Judicial Service as District Munsif in 1981 and worked at Kovvur, Eluru, Waltair etc., Joined Judicial Service as District Munsif in 1981 and worked at Kovvur, Eluru, Waltair etc., Promoted as Sub-Judge in April, 1991 and worked at Anakapalli and Bhimavaram., Promoted as District and Sessions Judge in December, 1996. Worked as I Additional District and Sessions Judge, Karimnagar; Registrar, A.P. Land Grabbing Court, Hyderabad; Judge, Family Court, Secunderabad; Presiding Officer, State Road Transport Appellate Tribunal, Hyderabad; I Additional District and Sessions Judge, Machilipatnam; Sessions Judge, Mahila Court, Vijayawada; Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Vijayawada; III Additional District and Sessions Judge, Tirupati; Principal District Judge, Nellore, Chittoor and Warangal Districts. Worked as Devasthanam Law Officer, Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam, Tirupati, Chittoor District. Elevated as an Additional Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on 20-01-2011 F.N. Appointed as Permanent Judge, High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad and assumed charge as Judge on 09-11-2012 F.N. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on the afternoon of 04-03-2013.]

Name: Sri Justice K.Suresh Reddy
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Kanchireddy Suresh Reddy was born on 07.12.1964 at Tarimela Village of Singanamala Mandal, Anantapuramu District in an agricultural family to Smt.K.Lakshmi Devi and Late Sri K.Sankar Reddy. He pursued Elementary Education in Zilla Parishad High School, Tarimela Village, Higher Grade Education at Vinay Kumar Telugu Medium High School, Anantapuramu, completed Graduation from Government Arts College, Anantapuramu and did Bachelor of Law (L.L.B.) Degree from Gulbarga University, Karnataka State. He got enrolled as an Advocate in the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh on 07.09.1989 and joined in the office of the learned Senior Counsel Sri T.Bali Reddy, and practiced in Civil, Criminal and Constitutional matters. Represented Sri Acharya N.G.Ranga Agricultural University during the years, 2008-2011 and elevated as a Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 02.05.2020.

Name: SRI JUSTICE K.UMAMAHESWARAM
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Kondagunta Umamaheswararam was born on 4th June, 1903. Educated at C.A.M. High School, Nellore, Presidency College, Madras and Law college, Madras. Enrolled as an Advocate of High Court on 27th July, 1925. Did Original and Appellate side work at the Bar. Appointed as Judge of the Madras High court on 26th November, 1953. Became Judge, Andhra High court on its formation from 5th July, 1954 and Judge, A.P. High court from 1.11.1956. Retired on 4th June, 1963. Died on 7.2.1965.]

Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice K.V. Gopalakrishna Nair was born on 7th June, 1911. Joined Judicial Service in Composite State of Madras on 8th June, 1942 as District Munsif. Went to Central Secretariat. Thereafter transferred to Jammu & Kashmir Government as Deputy Secretary and acted as Secretary, Law Department. Name: SRI JUSTICE K.V.L. NARASIMHAM
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice K.V.L. Narasimham was born on 1st April, 1910. Educated at Islamia School, Secunderabad, V.R. College High School, Nellore, Hindu High School, Vijayawada, Pachayappa's College, Madras and Law College, Madras. Enrolled as an Advocate of Madras High Court on 1st April, 1935. Joined State Higher Judicial Service in 1946. Came to Andhra State on its formation as District and Sessions Judge. Name: SRI JUSTICE KALYAN JYOTI SENGUPTA
Biodata: Born on 7th May, 1953. Enrolled as an advocate on 21st April, 1981. Practiced in the High Court in Civil, Constitutional and Criminal matters, Civil suits and Arbitration matters. Appointed as a permanent Judge of the Calcutta High Court on 17th July, 1997. Assumed charge as the Acting Chief Justice on and from October 5, 2012. His Lordship has held the office of Chairperson, High Court legal Services Committee and also of Executive-Chairman "State Legal Services Authority, West Bengal". Transferred to High Court of Uttarakhand at Nainital vide Notification dated 18/10/2012 and assumed charge of his office on 31/10/2012. He was Executive Chairman of the Uttarakhand State Legal Services Authority., Hon'ble Mr. Justice Kalyan Jyoti Sengupta assumed office of Chief Justice High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 21/05/2013. Retired as Chief Justice, High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh on attaining the age of superanuation i.e 62 years on 06.05.2015 AN.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE KOKA RAMACHANDRA RAO
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice K. Ramachandra Rao was born on 5.7.1922. Took his early education from Noble High School and Hindu College High School, Machilipatnam, Krishna District. Took his B.A. Degree from Loyola College, Madras and the Law Degree from Law College, Madras in 1943. Did his apprenticiship under Sri P.V. Rajamannar and Sri Koka Subba Rao. Enrolled as an Advocate in Madras High Court on 30th October, 1944 and as an Advocate, Supreme Court in 1953. Held various offices as Editor, Indian Law Reports, Standing Counsel for the Central Government, Legal Adviser to the Food Corporation of India and A.P. State Mining Corporation prior to his elevation to the Bench. He was also a member of the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh., Appointed as Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 21.8.1968.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE LOKUR, MADAN BHIMARAO
Biodata: Born on 31st December, 1953.Studied in Modern School, New Delhi, St. Joseph's Collegiate, Allahabad.Graduated in History (Hons.) from St. Stephen's College, Delhi University in 1974. Obtained LL.B. degree from Law Faculty, Delhi University in 1977.Enrolled as an Advocate-on-Record in the Supreme Court in 1981. , Appointed as Central Government Standing Counsel in December, 1990 and continued as such till December, 1996 during which period he handled all kind of cases on behalf of the Central Government including Commission of Inquiry and criminal trials in respect of economic offences.Designated as Senior Advocate in February, 1997.Appointed as Additional Solicitor General of India on 14th July, 1998 and continued as such till appointed as an Additional Judge of Delhi High Court on 19th February, 1999 and Permanent Judge of that High Court on 5th July, 1999. , Appointed as Chief Justice of Gauhati High Court on 24th June, 2010. As a Judge, has actively initiated judicial reforms and management of the justice delivery system, encouraged continuing judicial education, computerization of Courts, mediation, plea bargaining, juvenile justice, legal aid, legal education and infrastructure development. , Appointed as a member of the Mediation and Conciliation Project Committee of the Supreme Court of India in April, 2005. Appointed as Member of the Legal Education Committee of the Bar Council of India in 2011. Transferred as Chief Justice of High Court of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge of office as such on 15.11.2011. FN. Appointed as Judge of Supreme Court of India and relinquished the charge of the Office of Chief Justice of High Court of Andhra Pradesh on the forenoon of 04.06.2012.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE M.E.N.PATRUDU
Biodata: Full Name : Makena Eswara Narasimha Patrudu Father's Name : Makena Narasimha Charyulu Patrudu Mother's Name : Smt. Makena Venkataramanamma Wife's Name : Smt. Makena Lakshmi Son's name : Makena Vyjayanth, FAMILY HISTORY Native of Chintalapalem near Visakhapatnam Family profession is Ayurvedyam and Agriculture., Inamdars and Mokhashadhars Land Lords with agricultural wet lands, mango gardens, cashew nut orchids, casurana and coconut topes, paddy and sugar cane fields., Forefather was a Chief Commander of Royal Army and His Great Grandfathers are Asthana Raja Vydyulu of Vizianagaram Royal Family of Andhra Pradesh., His wife Smt. Lakshmi was an advocate. She has given up her 10 years of active practice on moral ground that being wife of District and Sessions Judge she should not continue in legal practice. Presently she is working as Lady Member in Consumer Forum-I, Hyderabad District, a Government service., EDUCATION Mr. M.E.N.Patrudu graduated from Mrs. AVN College, Visakhapatnam and obtained the Law degree from Andhra University, Visakhapatnam. He was never detained in any class throughout his educational career. A sportsman. He was elected as President, Law College, Andhra University and conducted number of seminars and symposiums. Few to name, Indian Ocean as Zone of Place, Legal education and the society. He was also President of Rotaract Club of Waltaire and presened RYLA Youth Leadership Award (International Award) by U.S.A. He was Chairman of Youth Hostel Association of India, A.P. State, Visakhapatnam Branch and has undertaken various youth leadership programmes., LEGAL PRACTICE Mr. Patrudu and his wife have started their profession at Visakhapatnam District Court in 1976., LAW TEACHER While practicing as a lawyer, he was a part-time lecturer, teaching Civil Procedure Code, Criminal Procedure Code and the Evidence Act in Nyaya Vidya Parishad evening College., PUBLIC PROSECUTOR He was appointed as Public Prosecutor of the Principal District Court, Visakhapatnam in 1984 and was the youngest Public Prosecutor ever appointed in the State of Andhra Pradesh and recognized as honest hardworking and intelligent prosecutor., JUDICIAL SERVICE He was selected as District and Sessions Judge, Grade II through direct recruitment in the year 1985 and was appointed in the year 1986. He was the youngest District Judge ever appointed in the State of Andhra Pradesh., POSTINGS 1st appointment as 1st Additional District and Sessions Judge, Krishna District the same day his wife has given up her practice, Special Judge for Essential Commodities Act at Hyderabad., III Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge for Dacoity Cases at Hyderabad., 1st Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge-cum-Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Hyderabad., Principal District & Sessions Judge at Mahbubnagar, and at Srikakulam., Principal Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Hyderabad and instrumental for Prashant Lok Adalats., District Judge, Warangal and his 3 years tenure is a history. He has introduced Jail Adalat, Grama Adalat and Pratidin Lok Adalat and for the first time in the country. He has carried the justice to the doorsteps of the people in the villages. He has gone into the interior villages, affected with extremist's problems in order to create legal awareness in the people. The Star T.V – Zee TV – NDTV has covered his programmes. His slogan “Your Problem – My Solution” has received the hearts of poor and innocent. The Jail Adalat in Central Prison on every Friday has received appreciation from the then Union Home Minister , CHIEF JUDGE, HYDERABAD CITY CIVIL COURT As Chief Judge in City Civil Court, Hyderabad for three years it is a Golden era. He has computerized the entire civil judicial administration in City Civil Court. City Civil Court online through website. City Civil Court on phone through I.V.R. has benefited the public to know about their case status at any time from any place in the world. Copy applications used to be furnished in no time through computers. Judgments were delivered and given on time. The depositions were typed on computers. A Diary of the Civil Court and postings and progress of each case of the day used to be available immediately. Work Management – Man Management and Case Management in the Court Management has reached its heights., Total transparency was maintained and the honesty, hard work was recognized., DIRECTOR OF PROSECUTIONS-CUM-EX-OFFICIO SECRETARY HOME, A founder Director of Prosecutions in the State of Andhra Pradesh and was the youngest Director of Prosecutions at the National Level. While working as Director of Prosecutions, he was made Ex-officio Secretary Home Government of A.P. He has introduced many innovative procedures making the prosecutors accountable for every act of prosecution and the department of prosecution to act as liaison between judiciary and Police. Prosecutors used to submit monthly statements. He made the prosecutor to file written arguments and submit case diary to court. Drafting of chargesheet and submit them to the court and numbering the charge sheets has become the responsibility of prosecutors. Opposing the bail by filing written memos with case diary and remand report was made mandatory. He has visited almost all Criminal Courts (Magistrate Courts) in the State and used to sit in the Court for long time to observe the performance of prosecutors and have close interactions with Superintendents of Police and with the District Collectors with the Station House Officers and the Judicial Officers at each place., Posting of cases before each Criminal Court as of one police station on one day was introduced by him and production of witnesses and accused without fail have yielded great results in disposal of criminal cases. The Judicial Magistrate used to send monthly confidential report about the performance of the prosecutor before his Court. Detailed check on the prosecutions was made practicable. , DIRECTOR OF A.P. JUDICIAL ACADEMY He was appointed as founder Additional Director of Judicial Academy and within three months was made as Director of Judicial Academy and during his 3 years tenure he developed the academy from scratch to sky and became a premier learning and training institution for judiciary in the entire country. , ACADEMIC He is an expert in court management, case management, time management, work management and man management in judiciary and his Book in the Subordinate Judiciary titled as Judicial Guidance and Judicial Governance on table. Docket Explosion – reasons and remedies and Legal Literacy and society apart from topics on management., He is a regular Guest Faculty to National Police Academy (N.P.A.) A.P. Police Academy, A.P. Judicial Academy and Lal Bahadur Sastry Academy at Mussorie and other premier training institutions in the country. He attended many International, National and State Level Seminars, Symposiums particularly on A.D.R. mechanism., REGISTRAR – HIGH COURT OF A.P. As Registrar Management he has taken all necessary steps in implementation of Supreme Court directions for providing the amenities to the judicial officers and he was in-charge of the work and conduct of subordinate courts. The disposal of cases has increased during this period. As Registrar Vigilance he has created an atmosphere of work culture and clean conduct and officers are made accountable for misconduct. Many judicial officers of questionable character have faced disciplinary actions., LEGAL SERVICES AUTHORITY As Member Secretary, A.P. State Legal Services Authority. Para legal volunteers in every village and making one village in each taluk as litigation free village forever is a tremendous service. E-Justice programmes are designed. Special Lok Adalats are being organized., He is Sworn in as an Additional Judge of Andhra Pradesh High Court on 04.01.2006 F.N., The Hon'ble Judge has been transferred as an Additional Judge of Madras High Court, Chennai and as such relinquished the office as an Additional Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh on the Afternoon of 04.03.2006 and he expired on 11.02.2007.]

He has introduced Jail Adalat, Grama Adalat and Pratidin Lok Adalat and for the first time in the country. He has carried the justice to the doorsteps of the people in the villages. He has gone into the interior villages, affected with extremist's problems in order to create legal awareness in the people. The Star T.V – Zee TV – NDTV has covered his programmes. His slogan “Your Problem – My Solution” has received the hearts of poor and innocent. The Jail Adalat in Central Prison on every Friday has received appreciation from the then Union Home Minister , CHIEF JUDGE, HYDERABAD CITY CIVIL COURT As Chief Judge in City Civil Court, Hyderabad for three years it is a Golden era. City Civil Court on phone through I.V.R. has benefited the public to know about their case status at any time from any place in the world. Copy applications used to be furnished in no time through computers. Judgments were delivered and given on time. The depositions were typed on computers. A Diary of the Civil Court and postings and progress of each case of the day used to be available immediately. Work Management – Man Management and Case Management in the Court Management has reached its heights., Total transparency was maintained and the honesty, hard work was recognized., DIRECTOR OF PROSECUTIONS-CUM-EX-OFFICIO SECRETARY HOME, A founder Director of Prosecutions in the State of Andhra Pradesh and was the youngest Director of Prosecutions at the National Level. Drafting of chargesheet and submit them to the court and numbering the charge sheets has become the responsibility of prosecutors. Docket Explosion – reasons and remedies and Legal Literacy and society apart from topics on management., He is a regular Guest Faculty to National Police Academy (N.P.A.) A.P. Police Academy, A.P. Judicial Academy and Lal Bahadur Sastry Academy at Mussorie and other premier training institutions in the country. Name: Sri Justice M.Ganga Rao
Court: High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh
Biodata: He was born on 08-04-1961 at Guntakal Village and Mandal, Anantapuramu District, Andhra Pradesh. He is the eldest son of Late Sri M.Chinthamani and Smt.M.Govindamma. He did his School Education in Zilla Parishad High School, Pendekal (R.S), Kurnool District. He studied Intermediate, C.E.C. Group, in Government Junior College, Anantapuramu, and Degree in Commerce in Government Degree College, Anantapuramu. He had obtained his Masters’ Degree in Commerce in the year 1983 and Law Degree from Osmania University in the year 1987. Enrolled on the rolls of the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh on 05.02.1988 and joined as junior in the Chambers of Sri Justice B.S.A.Swamy, when he was an Advocate, worked for three years and later worked in the Chambers of Sri Justice C.V.Ramulu, when he was Senior Central Government Standing Counsel in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh. He was engaged as an Assistant Government Pleader for Home from 1994 to 1996 in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh. Again, he was engaged as an Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue from 01.01.2001 to 05.05.2004 in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh. Later, he was engaged as Government Pleader for Transport, Roads and Buildings from 17-07-2009 to 16.07.2014. He was also engaged as an Additional Central Government Standing Counsel in High Court of Andhra Pradesh from 12.01.1995 to 16.01.1996. He had experience in Revenue, Transport and Service laws. Elevated to the Bench as a Judge of the High Court of Judicature for the State of Telangana and for the State of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge with effect from 21.09.2017.

Name: SRI JUSTICE M.N. RAO
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice M.N. Rao was born on 22.4.1936 at Nellore. Passed B.A., M.L. Educated B.A. at the V.R. College, Nellore and obtained Law Degree from Andhra University Waltair, obtained Master of Laws in Constitutional and International Law from the Madras University in 1961. Enrolled as an advocate and practised for more than 12 years at the High Court of Andhra Pradesh. Appointed as District and Sessions Judge in 1973 by direct recruitment. Name: SRI JUSTICE M.RANGA REDDY
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice M.Ranaga Reddy was born on 1st July, 1933 in a village at Anantapur district. He comes from middle class agricultural family. He had his school education in London Mission High School at Gooty and St. Johns High School at Bellary. He joined Government Arts College in the year 1949. After completing graduation in the above college he joined Law College at Madras in 1954. On completion of law in the year 1956 he enrolled in the year 1957. He practised at Anantapur Bar. He joined service in the year 1963 as Munsif Magistrate and promoted as Sub-Judge in the year 1971. He was promoted as Grade-II District Judge in the year 1975. He worked as Chairman of Land Reforms Appellate Tribunal during the year 1977 - 1979 at Khammam. He was promoted as Grade-I District Judge in the year 1983. He worked as Chairman, Sales tax Appellate Tribunal, and later as Chief Judge, City Civil Court, Hyderabad till his elevation as Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 16-03-1990 A.N.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE M.S. RAMACHANDRA RAO
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice M.S. Ramachandra Rao was born on 5th November, 1906. Had his College Education in Government Arts, college, Rajahmiundry and took Law Degree from Madras Law College. Was enrolled as an Advocate of High Court, Madras in 1928. Was junior to late Sri Somayya at the Madras Bar till his elevation to the Bench in 1939. Appeared in several cases of importance in the High Court at Madras. Guntur and Hyderabad. Acquired considerable work on Appellate side and was appointed as one of the Government pleaders of Andhra Pradesh in 1958. Was sworn in as Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 17.10.1960. Died in harness on 23.2.1961.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE M.S.RAMACHANDRA RAO
Biodata: Monday, January 17,2022, He was born on 7-8-1966 at Hyderabad. He studied SSC in St.Pauls High School, Hyderabad, Intermediate course from Little Flower College and B.ScHons Mathematics from Bhavans New Science College, Osmania University. He stood first in the University in B.Sc. Hons Mathematics course. He passed LL.B. from University College of Law, Osmania University, Hyderabad in 1989 and was awarded CVSS Acharyulu Gold Medal by the Osmania University for securing highest marks in the final year LL.B. He enrolled as an Advocate on 7-9-1989. He secured LL.M from the University of Cambridge, U.K. in 1991. He was awarded the Cambridge Common Wealth Scholarship and the Bank of Credit and Commerce International Scholarship for study of the LL.M Course at the Cambridge University, U.K. He was also awarded the Pegasus Scholarship by the Pegasus Scholarship Trust, Inner Temple, London headed by Lord Goff of Chievely, a Judicial Member of the House of Lords. Under this Scholarship, he was provided training in the Brick Court Chambers, Middle Temple, London and in Clifford Chance, a multinational Solicitors firm, London. As advocate, he was counsel for Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority, State Bank of India, State Bank of Hyderabad, District Cooperative Central Bank, Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd., A.P. State Financial Corporation, the Institute of Public Enterprise and the Securities and Exchange Board of India and several companies and financial institutions. He was also appointed by the State Government of Andhra Pradesh as a Special Government Pleader in the High Court to deal with Urban Land Ceiling Matters. He had practiced law in the areas of Civil Law, Arbitration, Company Law, Administrative and Constitutional Law, Labour and Service law. His father Justice M. Jagannatha Rao was a former Judge of the Supreme Court of India (1997-2000) and a former Chairman of Law Commission of India. His grand father M.S. Ramachandra Rao was also a Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh from 1960-61. His grandfathers -brother Justice M.Krishna Rao was a Judge of the High Court A.P. from 1966- 1973. His Lordship Sri Justice M.S. Ramachandra Rao was elevated as Addl. Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 29-6-2012. Appointed as Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on 04.12.2013. Appointed to perform the duties of the office of the Chief Justice, High Court for the State of Telangana w.e.f. 31-08-2021 forenoon. Transferred as Judge of Punjab and Haryana High court and assumed charge of office on the forenoon of 12-10-2021.

Name: Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Biodata: Born on 14th June, 1960, at Machilipatnam in a middleclass family. Had studies at Machilipatnam up to his graduation. Did his graduation in Commerce from Andhra Jatiya Kalasala, Machilipatnam. Studied law degree in Sir C.R.Reddy Law College, Eluru, and enrolled as a member on the rolls of the Bar Counsel of Andhra Pradesh and started practice at Machilipatnam. Was attached to the office of Sri Yakkala Pandu Ranga Rao, the then Government Pleader, Krishna at Machilipatnam, and gained exposure to various branches of law. Appointed as Standing Counsel for Machilipatnam Municipality in the year 1991 and worked as such till his appointment as District & Sessions Judge, Grade-II, by direct recruitment. Prized M.N.Rao Gold Medal from A.P. Judicial Academy as best Trainee District Judge for the year 1998. Served as Additional District Judge, Vizianagaram, Kurnool, Additional Chief Judge, City Small Cause Court, Hyderabad, Registrar Management for 4 months and Registrar Vigilance, High Court of A.P., Hyderabad, for a period of 2 years 10 months. Later, served as Principal District Judge, Guntur, East Godavari at Rajahmundry and again at Guntur till his elevation as Additional Judge, High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad, and sworn in as such on 23-10-2013. His wife Smt. M.V.Ramana Kumari is also a judicial officer, presently working as Senior Civil Judge. Appointed as Judge of High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on the afternoon of 02-03-2016.

Name: SRI JUSTICE M.SEETHARAMA MURTI
Biodata: Justice Mandhata Seetharama Murti hails from a family of Lawyers of Kakinada of East Godavari District. He is a third-generation Lawyer in the hierarchy and had actively practiced for 12 years, until his selection as a District Judge. He, an experienced Lawyer and a Judge, had also specialized in teaching and training Judicial Officers and Ministerial Officers of the Courts in the State of Andhra Pradesh. While working as a Senior Faculty and Additional Director of the Andhra Pradesh Judicial Academy he had compiled reading and reference material for the various academic programmes and in the process had worked with Judges of all Cadres, Academicians, Teachers, Jurists and Faculty and had compiled teaching materials and reference materials in the field of law and allied subjects. On his direct appointment in December, 1996 as a District Judge Gr. II in the Andhra Pradesh Higher Judicial Services, he had participated in the two months foundation course for the Direct Recruit District Judges in the Andhra Pradesh Judicial Academy. Afterwards, he had worked as Special Judge for SPE and ACB Cases-cum-II Additional District Judge, Nellore, III Additional District and Sessions Judge, Kurnool, Senior Faculty and Additional Director, Judicial Academy, Judge, Family Court, Special Judge for SPE and ACB Cases-cum-III Additional District and Sessions Judge, Special Judge for CBI Cases, Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Visakhapatnam, Principal District and Sessions Judge, Vizianagaram District, Principal District and Sessions Judge, Ranga Reddy District, Registrar General of the High Court, Chairman, Sales Tax Appellate Tribunal, Visakhapatnam, Chief Judge, City Civil Court, Hyderabad District. He was appointed as Additional Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh and sworn in as Additional Judge of the High Court on 23.10.2013. He was born on 16th of January. He holds a Degree in B. Sc., and Degree in Law, both from Andhra University. He won the Gold Medal for proficiency in Law of Torts in first Law apart from other prizes. He was awarded best trainee District Judge Gold Medal for the year 1996-97 by the Academy. He is married to Mrs. Srimatha and the couple is blessed with a daughter Ms. Srutha Keerthi and a son Master M. S. Atchyut Chittenna. He is passionate in meditation, listening to music, travelling and spending time with children. Appointed as Judge of High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on the afternoon of 02-03-2016. Laid down office on 15.01.2020 on attaining the age of superannuation.

Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice M.Venkateswara Reddy was born on 1st June, 1945 at Pedaogirala village in Krishna District in an agricultural family. Studes B.Sc in Andhra Layola College, Vijayawada. Name: Sri Justice Matam Venkata Ramana
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Matam Venkata Ramana was born on 12.02.1960 at Hyderabad. His Lordship hails from a well known Matam family of Advocates at Gooty, Ananthapuramu District, State of Andhra Pradesh. His Lordship had his schooling from Maltus Smith High School, Gooty. His Lordship completed Intermediate from S.V. Junior College, Tirupathi, B.Sc from Government College, Ananthapuramu and LL.B., from Sri Jagadguru Renukacharya College of Law, Bangalore. His Lordship completed LL.M., in Constitutional law from Osmania University, Hyderabad. His Lordship's great grandfather Sri late Matam Vedavyasachar, his grandfather Sri late Matam Sethu Rao, (a freedom fighter) and his father Sri late Matam Narayana Rao, practised as advocates at Gooty as well as in different Courts in Ananthapuram District. His Lordship is the last issue to his parents Sri late Matam Narayana Rao and Smt. Late Kamala Narayana Rao. His Lordship had his early professional training under his father Sri late Matam Narayana Rao and thereafter, was a Junior Advocate in the office of Sri Late K.S. Jayaram, Senior Advocate, Ananthapuram. His Lordship practised for five years. His Lordship was appointed as a District Munsif (Civil Judge, Junior Division) with effect from 01.04.1987. Thereafter, his Lordship worked at Chittoor, Piler, Nandyal and as VIII Assistant Judge, City Civil Court, Hyderabad. On promotion in the year 1993 as Sub-Judge (Civil Judge, Senior Division), his Lordship worked at Adoni, Nellore and Kurnool. On his promotion to the cadre of District Judge, his Lordship worked at Warangal; as The Registrar, Special Court For Cases under A.P. Land Grabbing Prohibition Act, Hyderabad; Senior Faculty Member, A.P. Judicial Academy, Secunderabad; Special Judge for SPE and ACB cases, Nellore; Principal District Judge, Warangal; Principal Special Judge for CBI Cases at Hyderabad and Principal District Judge, Kurnool. Thereafter, his Lordship was elevated as Judge of Hon'ble High Court of Andhra Pradesh with effect from 20.06.2019. His Lordship's wife Mrs. Prathima Ramana is daughter of Sri late Palle Sarvagnachar, Senior Advocate, Kadapa. His Lordship's son Mr. Srikar Raghottam is pursuing Research (Ph.d.,) in Linguistics from Rutgers University, New Jersey, USA, after completing B.E Hons.) from BITS, Pilani and Masters, from Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi.
LLB_Institutition: Sree Jagadguru Renukacharya College of Law, Bangalor

Name: SRI JUSTICE MOHAMMED AHMED ANSARI
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Mohammed Ahmed Ansari was born on 26th November 1901. Received Education at St. George's Grammar School, Hyderabad, Cambridge Preparatory school Dehra Dun: Wadham College, Oxford and Lincoln's Inn. Enrolled as an Advocate of Allahabad High Court in February 1928 and in Hyderabad High Court in November 1935. Did Civil, Criminal and Appellate work at the Bar. Appointed as Judge, Hyderabad High Court on 29th November 1946. Appointed as Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on Reorganisation of States with effect from 1st November 1956. Transferred as Judge of the Kerala High Court with effect from 4.12.1959. Appointed as Chief Justice of the Kerala High Court from 29.3.1960. Retired on 26th November 1961.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE N.BALAYOGI
Court: High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh
Biodata: Born on 15th January, 1957 at Peyyalavari Peta, Anathavaram Post, Mummidivaram Mandal, East Godavari District. Did graduation in Commerce from S.K.B.R College, Amalapuram. Studied B.L., in A.U Law College, Visakhapatnam. Enrolled as a member on the rolls of the Bar Counsel of Andhra Pradesh on 22-12-1980 and joined the Office of Sri Late V. Venkata Ramaiaiah Garu, Ex.Standing Counsel for South Central Railway and Ex-Advocate General, A.P. High Court, Hyderabad and gained exposure to various branches of law. Actively practiced in almost all branches of law at the then High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad and A.P. Administrative Tribunal, Hyderabad. Appointed as Munisff Magistrate on 07.10.1985. After rendering services in different places as Junior Civil Judge, Senior Civil Judge and Additional District Judge, promoted as Principal District & Sessions Judge, Kurnool on 30-06-2010. Served as Chairman, Industrial Tribunal-I, Hyderabad from 02-04-2012 to 23-11-2013, as Principal Special Judge for CBI Cases, Hyderabad from 23-11-2013 to 09-07-2015 and as Chief Judge, City Civil Court, Hyderabad from 10-07-2015 to 16-01-2017. Elevated as Judge of High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on the forenoon of 17-01-2017. Laid down office on 14.01.2019 on attaining the age of superannuation.

Name: SRI JUSTICE N.D. KRISHNA RAO
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice N.D. Krishna Rao was born on 19th July, 1904. Name: SRI JUSTICE N.R.L.NAGESWARA RAO
Biodata: Born in July 1951 in the family of reputed lawyers from Narasaraopet, Guntur District. His father late Sri Venkata Appa Rao was a Senior Advocate with 60 years standing at Bar and commanded good civil practice. Grand father late Sri Hanumantha Rao was also a senior Lawyer of 50 years standing. Had his earlier education up to Degree at Narasaraopet. Did Law degree in Andhra University, Visakhapatnam from 1969 to 1972 and secured First Class and enrolled as Advocate in the month of September 1973 and practiced competently with his father. Later joined in the service as Junior Civil Judge in 1979, promoted as Senior Civil Judge in 1988 and as District Judge in the year 1995. Worked as Additional District Judge at Nizamabad, Nalgonda, Ranga Reddy and Sangareddy Districts. Worked as Principal District Judge at Vizianagaram, Nalgonda, Warangal, Nellore and in Visakhapatnam. Blessed with one son and two daughters., Elevated as an Additional Judge of High Court of A.P., and assumed charge as such on 15.11.2010 FN. Appointed as permanent Judge, High Court of A.P., and assumed charge as Judge on 19-01-2012 F.N. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on 25-07-2013.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE N.V.RAMANA
Biodata: N.V. Ramana, B.Sc., B.L., was born in an agricultural family on August 27, 1957 in Ponnavaram village, Krishna District. He enrolled as an Advocate on February 10, 1983. He has practiced in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Central and Andhra Pradesh Administrative Tribunals and the Supreme Courts of India in Civil, Criminal, Constitutional, Labour, Service and Election matters. He has specialized in Constitutional, Criminal, Service and Inter-State River laws. He has functioned as Panel Counsel for various Government Organizations. He has also functioned as Panel Counsel for various Government Organizations. He has functioned as Additional Standing Counsel for Central Government and Standing Counsel for Railways in the Central Administrative Tribunal at Hyderabad. He has also functioned as Additional Advocate General of Andhra Pradesh. He was appointed as a permanent Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court on June 27, 2000 and is functioning as such. He had participated in several National and International Conferences held in India and abroad and submitted papers on various topics of legal importance. He is the President of the A.P. Judicial Academy. He is also the Executive Chairman of the A.P. Legal Services Authority. Biodata: N.V. Ramana, B.Sc., B.L., was born in an agricultural family on August 27, 1957 in Ponnavaram village, Krishna District. He enrolled as an Advocate on February 10, 1983. He has practiced in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Central and Andhra Pradesh Administrative Tribunals and the Supreme Courts of India in Civil, Criminal, Constitutional, Labour, Service and Election matters. He has specialized in Constitutional, Criminal, Service and Inter-State River laws. He has functioned as Panel Counsel for various Government Organizations. He has also functioned as Panel Counsel for various Government Organizations. He has functioned as Additional Standing Counsel for Central Government and Standing Counsel for Railways in the Central Administrative Tribunal at Hyderabad. He has also functioned as Additional Advocate General of Andhra Pradesh. He was appointed as a permanent Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court on June 27, 2000 and is functioning as such. He had participated in several National and International Conferences held in India and abroad and submitted papers on various topics of legal importance. He is the President of the A.P. Judicial Academy. He is also the Executive Chairman of the A.P. Legal Services Authority. Appointed as Chief Justice of High Court of Delhi and assumed charge as such on the afternoon of 02.09.2013.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE N.Y. HANUMANTHAPPA
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice N.Y. Hanumanthappa was born on 25.9.1939 in Rampura, Karnataka State. Passed M.A., B.L., LL.M. Name: Sri Justice Ninala Jayasurya
Biodata: Born on 27.08.1968 at Tadepalli, Guntur District to Smt. Indira Devi and Shri NVV Krishna Rao, who worked as Senior Assistant Public Prosecutor in West Godavari, Krishna, Guntur and East Godavari Districts. Had his school education in Z.P.Boys High School, Tanuku, West Godavari District. Did Graduation in B.Com from Government Arts College, Rajahmundry. Thereafter studied Law in Siddhartha Law College, Vijayawada and obtained Degree in Bachelor of Law from Nagarjuna University. After enrolling as an Advocate on the rolls of Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh in the year 1992, joined the office of Shri Talari Anantha Babu, Former Advocate General of Andhra Pradesh and Senior Advocate of erstwhile High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad. Appointed as a Special Government Pleader, Office of the Advocate General during 2003-2004 and later as Government Pleader, Agriculture, Co-operation and Marketing Departments, Government of Andhra Pradesh in the year 2009 and discharged functions till 2014 for five years. Dealt with various cases on behalf of Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh, BHEL, APCO & NTR Vaidya Seva Trust (presently YSR Aarogyasri Health Care Trust) as Panel Advocate and appeared for various Government undertakings including APSTC, STC of India, HUDA and other departments in different cases. Practiced in the erstwhile High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad as well as High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Amaravati and dealt with cases in Writ, Arbitration, Civil and other branches of Law till the date of elevation. Appointed as Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Amaravati and assumed charge as such on 13.01.2020.

Name: SRI JUSTICE NISAR AHMAD KAKRU
Biodata: Born on 26th October, 1949. Enrolled as a Pleader in August 1975, Vakil on 6th February 1979 and Advocate on 1st April 1982. Practised in the District and Sessions Court and other Courts at Baramulla from August 1975. Was appointed as Public Prosecutor in the District and Sessions Court Baramulla in the year 1978. Relinquished the office of the Public Prosecutor by resignation in the year 1981 in view of the order issued by Government of Jammu and Kashmir, debarring the Public Prosecutors of the State from their private practice. Continued to practice at Baramulla till 1984. Started practice in the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir in 1984 in Civil, Criminal, Constitutional, Service, Labour, Revenue and Company matters. Was appointed by the Government of Jammu and Kashmir as the Chief Government Advocate /Additional Advocate General in the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and functioned as such from February 1988 till his resignation, tendered in December 1990 because of the reason that the popular Government which had reposed confidence in him, ceased to be in power due to imposition of the Governor's rule in the State. Resumed private practice in the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir. Was appointed as Advocate General of the Jammu and Kashmir State in the month of November 1996. Functioned and continued as Advocate General till his elevation to the bench of the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir in the month of November 1997. Functioned as Acting Chief Justice of Jammu and Kashmir from 01.04.2007 to 06.06.2007, 12.11.2007 to 07.01.2008 and 20.10.2008 to 02.01.2009. Transferred to the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on elevation. Took oath on 19th February, 2010 as Chief Justice of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation i.e., 62 years on 25.10.2011 AN.

Name: SRI JUSTICE NOUSHAD ALI
Biodata: Hon'ble Mr.Justice Noushad Ali was born on 08th March, 1952 to late Sri Md.Usman Saheb and Smt.Rabia Bee in Palamaner, Chittoor District. Graduated from S.V.Arts College, Tirupati and obtained law degree and M.S.W. from Bangalore University., Enrolled as an Advocate on 14-06-1976 and set up independent practice in the High court of Andhra Pradesh appearing in civil, transport and constitutional cases. Commission for Minorities., Sworn-in as Additional Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 18-12-2009. Appointed as Judge, High Court of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such, on 26-11-2010. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on the afternoon of 07-03-2014.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE O. CHINNAPPA REDDI
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice O. Chinnappa Reddi was born on 25th September, 1922. Educated at London Mission High School, Gooty, Loyola College, Madras, Law College, Madras. Enrolled as an Advocate of the High Court of Madras on 21.8.1944. Did both Civil and Criminal but mainly Criminal work at Hyderabad. Appointed as Public Prosecutor from 21.6.60 and continued as such till his appointment as Additional Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh for a period of 2 years with effect from 21.8.1967. Permanent Judge on 27.11.1967. Transferred from Andhra Pradesh High Court to Punjab and Haryana High Court and assumed charge with effect from 28.6.1976 (F.N.) Retransferred as Judge of Andhra Pradesh High Court from 9.9.1977., Appointed as Judge, Supreme Court of India with effect from 17.1.1978.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE P. BASI REDDY
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice P. Basi Reddy was born on 20th August, 1906. Took his B.A.(Hons.) degree from the presidency College, Madras. Went to England to study in London School of Economics and was subsequently called to the Bar from gray's Inn, London in 1931. Worked with Mr. Nugent Grant and Mr. V.L. Ethiraj. Name: SRI JUSTICE P. CHENNAKESAV REDDI
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice P. Chennakesav Reddi was born on 3.11.1924. Educated at Board's High School, Pulivendla, Cuddapah District. C.D. College, Anantapur and Law College, Madras. Enrolled as an Advocate in the Madras High Court on 28.7.1952. Did his Apprenticeship in the Chambers of Late Sri M.S. Ramachandra Rao, who later became a Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court. Name: SRI JUSTICE P. RAMA RAO
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice P. Rama Rao had High School education at Gudivada, Krishna district and Intermediate in Hindu College, Machilipatnam, B.A. in A.C. College, Guntur and M.A. & LL.B., in Lucknow University. Enrolled as an Advocate in the Madras High Court. Apprentice in the Office of Sri P. Chandra Reddy, former chief Justice of Andhra Pradesh High Court. Standing Counsel for Income-tax department from 1970 to 1981 and Counsel for the Institute of chartered Accountants of India. Former President of High Court Advocates’ Association and former Member of Regional Board of direct Taxes. Founder-President of Forum of Tax Laws. Former member of Law Reporting Council and former Chairman of Disciplinary committee of Bar Council. Appointed as High court Judge from 16.9.1981.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE P. RAMACHANDRA RAJU
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice P.Ramachandra Raju was born on 8th April, 1923. Recipient of Sir John Wallace Gold Medal. Enrolled as an Advocate of Madras High Court on 30th July, 1945. Joined Judicial Service as District Munsif on 9-9-1950. Officiated as District and Sessions Judge from 17-9-1965 (A.N). Confirmed as District Judge. Grade-I on 17-10-1974. Appointed as an Additional Judge on 10th November, 1978. Appointed as permanent Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 12-7-1979 A.N.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE P. RAMAKRISHNAM RAJU
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice P. Ramakrishnam Raju was born on 9.11.1936 at Kothapadu Village of Tanuku Taluq of West Godavari District. Passed B.A.B.L. College education at Government Arts College of Rajahmundry. Law Degree from Andhra University Waltair. Enrolled as a members of the Bar in June 1959. In the year 1966 shifted the practice to High Court of A.P. Appointed as Permanent Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 4.11.1992. Retired on 9.11.1998.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE P. SATYANARAYANA RAJU
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice P. Satyanarayana Raju was born on 17th August, 1908. Educated in Board High School, Tanuku, West Godavari District and Maharajah's College, Vizianagaram. Took Law Degree from Law College, Madras and joined the Madras Bar in 1930. Associated himself with late Sri T. Prakasam for 3 years and later with Sri P. Satyanarayana Rao, who was an accredited leader of the Madras Bar. Became the Government Pleader of the Composite state of Madras in 1950 and State Counsel in 1951. When Andhra State was formed he became the Government Pleader of Andhra State in 1953., Appointed as Judge of Andhra High Court from 1st November, 1954. Acted as Chief Justice of Andhra Pradesh High Court once in November, 1963 and again in June, 1964. Again appointed as Acting Chief Justice on 23rd November 1964 and as permanent Chief Justice on 30th December, 1964., Appointed Judge, Supreme Court of India on 20th October, 1965. Died in harness on 20th April, 1966.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE P. SRIRAMULU
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice P. Sriramulu was born on 2.6.1913. Educated at Mahboob College, Secunderabad, Nizam College, Hyderabad, Law College, Madras. Enrolled as a I-Grade Pleader on 17.12.1940 and as an Advocate on 10.10.1952 in the High Court of Hyderabad. Practised on Civil and Criminal side at Secunderabad and Hyderabad. Served as District and Sessions Judge in the then Hyderabad State. Later as District and Sessions Judge in Andhra Pradesh. Worked as Judicial Member, Income-Tax Appellate Tribunal, President Income-Tax Appellate Tribunal, Government of India at Bombay. Appointed as Additional Judge of Andhra Pradesh High Court for a period of two years with effect from 23.10.1969. Appointed permanent Judge on 22.12.1970. Retired on 2.6.1975]

Name: SRI JUSTICE P.A.CHOUDARY
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice P.A.Choudary was born on 1st July, 1926. Had his High School Educatin at Pedanandipadu and Baptla, Guntur District. Did his Intermediate and B.A. from A.C.College, Guntur. Took M.A., Degree in Economics from Andhra University, Waltair took his B.L. Degree from Law College, Madras. Was enrolled as an Advocate in Madras High Court in 1952 after having his apprenticeship in the Office of the then Senior Advocate of Madras, Sri D.Minikannaiah, who later on adorned the Bench of A.P. High Court. Worked as paid Research Scholar in Constitutional Law and International Law at Madras University under the guidance of Professor Alexandrowicz during 1952 to 1954. At Hyderabad worked as Lecturer in Law College for 3 years to teach Constitutional Law to L.L.B., students. Enrolled as an Advocate, Supreme Court on 8-2-1978. Author of several articles on Legal topics. Made a critical review of Supreme Court decisions in the India Year Book of International Affairs, 1953, published by the Madras Unviersity. Appointed as permanent Judge of the A.P. High Court on 10-11-1978.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE P.CHANDRA REDDI
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice P. Chandra Reddi was born on 1st July, 1904. Educated at V.R. High School, Nellore and Pachaiyappa's College, Madras. Enrolled as an Advocate of the High Court of Madras on 13th August, 1928. Practised on the Civil and Criminal – Original and Appellate sides. Appointed as Additional Judge, Madras High Court on 16th July, 1949 and as Permanent Judge, Andhra High Court on its formation, from 5th July, 1954., Appointed as Acting Chief Justice of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 31st January, 1958. Permanent Chief Justice of that High Court from 16th June, 1958. Acting Governor of Andhra Pradesh from 20.11.1963 to 19.12.1963., Appointed Chief Justice, Madras High Court on 23.11.1964. Acting Governor of Tamil Nadu from 24.11.1964 to 7.2.1965. Retired on 1.7.1966.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE P.CHENNAKESAV REDDI
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice P. Chennakesav Reddi was born on 3.11.1924. Educated at Board's High School, Pulivendla, Cuddapah District. C.D. College, Anantapur and Law College, Madras. Enrolled as an Advocate in the Madras High Court on 28.7.1952. Did his Apprenticeship in the Chambers of Late Sri M.S. Ramachandra Rao, who later became a Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court. Later joined the Office of Sri P. Basi Reddy, the doyen of the Criminal Bar who was later elevated to Bench in 1957. Set up independent practice since 1957. Appeared mostly in Civil, Criminal and Constitutional matters. Member, State Bar Council and Disciplinary Proceedings Committee of the Bar Council from 1961 to 1964. Worked as Central Government Standing Counsel, Special Police Establishment Cases from January, 1970. Was Legal Adviser to some prominent Government Industrial Undertakings., Appointed as Additional Judge of Andhra Pradesh High Court for two years with effect from, 10.5.1972. Appointed as permanent Judge on 10.6.1973.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE P.DURGA PRASAD
Biodata: Born on 20.02.1951 at Machilipatnam, Krishna District to Smt. Subbaravamma and Late Sri Sastrulu Naidu. His late father was a District & Sessions Judge., Had primary education at Nandyala, Guntur, Palakolu, Rajahmundry, Kaialuru, Narasapuram., Obtained B.Sc., degree from Sir C.R.Reddy College, Eluru. Obtained B.L., Degree from Andhra University Law College, Visakhapatnam., Enrolled as Advocate in the year 1975. Initially practiced at Vijayawada along with Sri K.Ranganayakulu, Advocate. Shifted to Hyderabad in the year 1977 and worked in the office of Late Sri Amancharla Krishna Murty, leading practitioner in Industrial and Labour Laws., Joined Judicial Service as District Munisif in April, 1981. Worked at Ongole, Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad, Munisif Magsitrate Nirmal, Medchal, Assistant Judge, Secunderabad, Metropolitan Magistrate, Secunderabad., Promoted as Sub-Judge in May, 1989 and worked at Khammam, Tadepalligudem, Assistant Directore of Law, A.P.Police Academy, Hyderabad., Promoted as District & Sessions Judge in March, 1995. Worked as Judge Family Court at Visakhapatnam, Additional District & Sessions Judge, Visakhapatnam, Registrar, A.P. Administrative Tribunal, Hyderabad, Chairman, Industrial Tribunal-cum-Labour Court, Guntur, Prinicipal District & Sessions Judge, Prakasam District at Ongole, Chairman Additional Industrial Tribunal-cum-Labour Court, Hyderabad, Additional Chief Judge, Secunderabad, Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Hyderabad, Registrar Administration, High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Registrar General, High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad, Principal District & Sessions Judge, Chittor, Chief Judge, City Civil Court, Hyderabad. Elevated as an Additional Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on 15.11.2010. F.N., Appointed as permanent Judge, High Court of A.P., and assumed charge as Judge on 19-01-2012 F.N. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on the afternoon of 19.02.2013.

Name: SRI JUSTICE P.KESHAVA RAO
Court: High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh
Biodata: Monday, January 17,2022, Born on 29th March, 1961 to Sri Potlapalli Prakash Rao and Smt. Potlapalli Jayaprada. Sri P. Prakash Rao was a government employee and retired as Assistant Director of Marketing. Married to Smt.P. Usha who is working as Finance Manager in a Software Company. Did his graduation in Sciences from Kakatiya Degree College, Warangal. Secured Law Degree from Kakatiya University in the year 1986 and enrolled as a Member on the rolls of Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh in April, 1986. Originally, was attached to the Office of late Sri Pingle Sambasiva Rao in Warangal District Headquarters Courts. Later, in the year 1991, shifted to Hyderabad and joined the Office of late Sri M.V. Ramana Reddy. In the year 1996 became independent and practiced in various branches of law which include Constitutional, Civil, Criminal and Election matters. Represented the Unified State of Andhra Pradesh as a Government Pleader attached to the Office of Sri D. Prakash Reddy, the then Additional Advocate General from October, 1998 to October, 2001. In the month of March, 2010 appointed as Special Standing Counsel for CBI (Special Public Prosecutor) and continued as such till April, 2016. Again in the month of September, 2016, the C.B.I. engaged the services for doing the specially entrusted high profile cases. In March, 2015 appointed as Standing Counsel for Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation GHMC and continued as such till elevation. Similarly, served as Standing Counsel for Quli Qutub Shah Urban Development Authority from October, 2015 onwards. Elevated to the Bench as a Judge of the High Court of Judicature for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge with effect from 21.09.2017. Expired on 09-08-2021 while in service.]

Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice P.L.N. Sarma was born on 24.4.1933 at Kunchavaram Village, Tenali Taluk, Guntur District. Passed B.Sc., B.L. Name: SRI JUSTICE P.LAKSHMANA REDDY
Biodata: Born in an agriculture family on 18.04.1945 in a tiny village Paidipalem, Simhadripuram Mandal, Kadapa District and had primary education in the village; High School Education in Zilla Parishad High School, Kondapuram and Simhadripuram, Kadapa District. Studied B.Sc. at Kadapa and obtained Law Degree from B.M.S. College, Bangalore. Did Post Graduation in Social Science and Administration in the National Institute of Social Science, Bangalore. Enrolled as an Advocate in the month of December, 1972 and practiced at District Court, Kadapa in the office of late Utukuru Ramireddy, Ex. M.P., a leading Criminal Lawyer, at Kadapa. Appointed as District Munsif in the month of August, 1976 and worked as District Munsif at Tadepalligudem, Dharmavaram and Tadipatri. Worked as Assistant Sessions Judge-cum-Subordinate Judge at Madanapalle, Gooty and Ananthapur. Promoted as District and Sessions Judge Grade-II in the year 1990 and worked as Additional District Judge at Karimnagar, Tirupathi, Rajahmundry and Kurnool. Worked as Principal District Judge, Sangareddy at Medak, Visakhapatnam, Khammam, Prakasam District at Ongole and Adilabad. Promoted as District and Sessions Judge Grade – I in the year 1997. Worked as Presiding Officer, Labour Court, Hyderabad and also worked as Director, A.P. Judicial Academy, Secunderabad. Worked as Chairman, Sales Tax Appellate Tribunal, Hyderabad and also served as Registrar General, High Court of A.P., Hyderabad. He was elevated as Additional Judge, High Court A.P., and sworn in on 26.05. 2005. Appointed as a Permanent Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court on 20-02-2006 F.N., The Hon'ble Sri Justice P.Lakshmana Reddy, Judge, High Court of A.P., has relieved himself from the office of Judge, on the afternoon of 13.02.2007, consequent upon his appointment as Vice-Chairman, Central Administrative Tribunal, Hyderabad Bench at Hyderabad. Retired as Judge, High Court of A.P., Hyderabad on the Forenoon of 18.04.2007.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE P.S.NARAYANA
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Pemmasani Sankara Narayana popularly known as P.S.Narayana was born on 13th July 1948 at Chinthakalva village near Tirupati, a holy town in Chittoor District of Andhra Pradesh, India. He had his early elementary education at Tiruthani and Karvetinagar and High School education at P.M. High School, Renigunta. He had obtained his B.Sc., degree from S.V. Arts College, Tirupati and obtained his B.L. Degree from S.V. University College, Tirupati. He did M.A. Post graduation degree in Public Administration. Enrolled as an Advocate on 10th October 1973 originally on the Rolls of Bar Council of Madras. Initially he had practiced for about a decade at Tirupati in Chittoor District. He had the privilege of working as a Junior Advocate in the Chambers of Sri Balamuri Radhakrishnaiah and Sri Madabhushi Krishnaswami the two leading advocates of Tirupati Bar who are no more, for some time and then began his independent practice at Tirupati and shifted his practice to the High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad. He was commanding a good volume of work in Civil and Criminal cases while practising at Tirupati. After shifting to Hyderabad he had commenced his practice as an independent professional and within a short time he commanded a good volume of work in all branches of law like Constitution, Civil Criminal etc., and he has been an income tax assesse for the last five years. He was also a panel advocate of the Andhra Pradesh High Court Legal Services Committee. Apart from this he had worked as Chief Editor of Andhra Weekly Reporter and also Andhra Law Times Criminal for some time and he was also the honorary editor of Andhra Law times till recently. He had delivered several lectures relating to different aspects at Judicial Academy and also at different academic institutions on their invitation. He had contributed several articles on different aspects of law to several Law Journals like Andhra Weekly Reporter, Supreme Court Journal, Madras Law Journal Criminal, Andhra Law Times, Andhra Law Times Criminal and also several other Law journals.He had contributed about fifty books to the Legal Literature., Elevated as Additional Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh and sworn-in on 25th June 2001 and appointed as permanent Judge on 31.07.2002 F.N. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on 12.07.2010 A.N.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE P.SATYANARAYANA RAJU
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice P. Satyanarayana Raju was born on 17th August, 1908. Educated in Board High School, Tanuku, West Godavari District and Maharajah's College, Vizianagaram. Took Law Degree from Law College, Madras and joined the Madras Bar in 1930. Associated himself with late Sri T. Prakasam for 3 years and later with Sri P. Satyanarayana Rao, who was an accredited leader of the Madras Bar. Became the Government Pleader of the Composite state of Madras in 1950 and State Counsel in 1951. When Andhra State was formed he became the Government Pleader of Andhra State in 1953., Appointed as Judge of Andhra High Court from 1st November, 1954. Acted as Chief Justice of Andhra Pradesh High Court once in November, 1963 and again in June, 1964. Again appointed as Acting Chief Justice on 23rd November 1964 and as permanent Chief Justice on 30th December, 1964., Appointed Judge, Supreme Court of India on 20th October, 1965. Died in harness on 20th April, 1966.]

Again appointed as Acting Chief Justice on 23rd November 1964 and as permanent Chief Justice on 30th December, 1964., Appointed Judge, Supreme Court of India on 20th October, 1965. Died in harness on 20th April, 1966.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE P.SWAROOP REDDY
Biodata: Sri P. Swaroop Reddy, born on 10.01.1949 in an agricultural family at Pamulparthy village of Medak District. Had his primary education at the village itself and studied from High School on wards at Hyderabad and completed B.Sc., and LL.M., from Osmania University. Enrolled as an Advocate in the year 1972 and joined in the Chambers of Sri E.Ayyapu Reddy, a leading Criminal Lawyer. Joined in the State Judicial Service as a District Munsif in the year 1976, promoted as Subordinate Judge and District Judge and worked at various places throughout the State. Also worked as Registrar Judicial, Registrar Administration and Registrar General of High Court of Andhra Pradesh., He is sworn in as an Additional Judge of Andhra Pradesh High Court on 26-05-2005 F.N. Appointed as a Permanent Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court on 20-02-2006 F.N. Retired as Judge, High Court of Andhra Pradesh on attaining the age of superannuation on 09-01-2011 A.N.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE P.V.SANJAY KUMAR
Biodata: Monday, January 17,2022, Born on 14th August, 1963 to late Sri P.Ramachandra Reddy and Smt. P.Padmavathamma. Late Sri P.Ramachandra Reddy was the Former Advocate General of Andhra Pradesh (1969 to 1982). Did his graduation in Commerce from Nizam College, Hyderabad. Secured Law Degree from Delhi University in the year 1988 and enrolled as a member on the rolls of the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh in August, 1988. Was attached to the Office of his father and gained exposure to various branches of law. After the retirement of his father from the profession, he practised independently and represented the High Court of Andhra Pradesh and Subordinate Judiciary, Hindusthan Petroleum Corporation Limited, Indian Oil Corporation Limited and the Special Officer, Urban Land Ceilings, Hyderabad, in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh. Also served as Government Pleader in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh from 2000-2003. Elevated to the Bench as Additional Judge, High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad, on 8th August, 2008. Assumed charge as Permanent Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 20.01.2010. Transferred as a Judge of High Court of Punjab and Haryana, Chandigarh and assumed charge as such on the forenoon of 14.10.2019.]
LLB_Institutition: Faculty of Law, University of Delhi

Name: Sri Justice Prashant Kumar Mishra
Biodata: Born on August 29, 1964 at Raigarh Chhattisgarh. Took B.Sc. and LL.B Degrees from Guru Ghasidas University, Bilaspur Chhattisgarh. Enrolled as an Advocate on September 4, 1987. Practiced law in District Court at Raigarh, High Court of Madhya Pradesh at Jabalpur and High Court of Chhattisgarh at Bilaspur and dealt with Civil, Criminal and Writ branches of law. Was designated as Senior Advocate by High Court of Chhattisgarh in January, 2005. Had been Chairman of Chhattisgarh State Bar Council for a period of 2\BD years. Was appointed/co-opted Member of the Rule Making Committee of High Court of Chhattisgarh. Had been Chancellor's Nominee in the Executive Council of Guru Ghasidas University, Bilaspur. Was associated with Hidayatullah National Law University, Raipur Chhattisgarh as its Ex-Officio Member in the Executive Council. Served as Additional Advocate General for the State of Chhattisgarh from June 26, 2004 to August 31, 2007 and thereafter as Advocate General for the State from September 1, 2007 till elevation. Elevated as a Judge of High Court of Chhattisgarh on December 10, 2009. Was Acting Chief Justice of High Court of Chhattisgarh from 01.6.2021 to 11.10.2021. Appointed as Chief Justice of High Court of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge of the Office of the Chief Justice, High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 13.10.2021.

Name: SRI JUSTICE R.M.BAPAT
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Ramesh Madhav Bapat hails from an illustrious Maharashtrian family of Legal luminaries. He was born on 30th April, 1941 in Maharashtra State, India. His respected great grand-father was a reputed Lawyer. His revered grand-father though a Law Graduate worked in a coveted Post in the erstwhile Princely state of Mysore. His grandfather's brother was also a famous Lawyer. His beloved father was a Garrison Engineer. Sri Ramesh did schooling in various Institutions in the State of Gujarat and Maharashtra, at places where his father was posted. He did his intermediate and B.Sc.,(Hons.) from the University of Pune. He obtained his Law Degree in 1965 from Pune University. He worked for two years in the Chamber of Sri C.B. Agarwal, Bar-at-Law. He mainly practiced in Civil Side. He was Standing Counsel for several leading and famous private Companies. , Sri Ramesh was selected as District & Sessions Judge in 1979 and posted at Thane. Subsequently he was appointed as Additional Registrar of Nagpur Bench of Bombay High Court. In 1984 he was transferred to Ratnagiri as District & Sessions Judge and later to Parbani. (Parbani was part and parcel of the erstwhile Nizam State). At Parbani Shri Ramesh, as District and Sessions Judge disposed of all the old pending Revision Applications against the orders passed by the Magistrates U/S-125 Cr.P.C., by the time he was transferred to Nagpur in August 1989., In November, 1990 he was appointed as Registrar, Bombay High Court. Later he worked as Principal Judge, Family Court, Bombay. Shri Ramesh made a name in the history of Maharashtra State as the only Judge whose disposal rate was the highest., Shri Ramesh was elevated as an Additional Judge of the Bombay High Court on 20th January, 1994. Later transferred to Andhra Pradesh as Additional Judge of Andhra Pradesh High Court on 11th Februray, 1994 and appointed as a Judge of A.P. High Court w.e.f. 7.7.1995. Justice Shri Ramesh is fond of literature and more interested in Judicial work.]

His grandfather's brother was also a famous Lawyer. His beloved father was a Garrison Engineer. Sri Ramesh did schooling in various Institutions in the State of Gujarat and Maharashtra, at places where his father was posted. He did his intermediate and B.Sc.,(Hons.) from the University of Pune. He obtained his Law Degree in 1965 from Pune University. He worked for two years in the Chamber of Sri C.B. Agarwal, Bar-at-Law. He mainly practiced in Civil Side. He was Standing Counsel for several leading and famous private Companies. , Sri Ramesh was selected as District & Sessions Judge in 1979 and posted at Thane. Subsequently he was appointed as Additional Registrar of Nagpur Bench of Bombay High Court. In 1984 he was transferred to Ratnagiri as District & Sessions Judge and later to Parbani. (Parbani was part and parcel of the erstwhile Nizam State). At Parbani Shri Ramesh, as District and Sessions Judge disposed of all the old pending Revision Applications against the orders passed by the Magistrates U/S-125 Cr.P.C., by the time he was transferred to Nagpur in August 1989., In November, 1990 he was appointed as Registrar, Bombay High Court. Later he worked as Principal Judge, Family Court, Bombay. Shri Ramesh made a name in the history of Maharashtra State as the only Judge whose disposal rate was the highest., Shri Ramesh was elevated as an Additional Judge of the Bombay High Court on 20th January, 1994. Later transferred to Andhra Pradesh as Additional Judge of Andhra Pradesh High Court on 11th Februray, 1994 and appointed as a Judge of A.P. High Court w.e.f. 7.7.1995. Justice Shri Ramesh is fond of literature and more interested in Judicial work.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE R.SUBHASH REDDY
Biodata: Born in the year 1957 in an agricultural family in Kamaram village of Chinna Shankarampet Mandal, Medak District. Had his primary education in Upper Primary School and Higher Education in Zilla Parishad High School, Sankarampet, Medak District. Passed Intermediate and graduation from Andhra Vidyalaya College (AV College), Hyderabad. Obtained Law Degree from the University College of Law, Osmania University, Hyderabad. Enrolled as an Advocate on the rolls of the Bar Council of Andhra Pradesh on 30/10/1980 and joined the Chambers of Sri Justice B.Subhashan Reddy (As Advocate as he then was). Actively Practised in Civil, Criminal, Constitutional and almost all other branches of Law. Had developed his independent practice with in short span of time and extensively dealt with number of cases covering all branches of Law. Deeply interested in philosophy, culture, music and education. Was Standing Counsel for premier institutions like S.V.University and Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University. Elected unanimously as the President of the AP High Court Advocates Association for the year 2001-2002. Elevated as Additional Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 02.12.2002. Sworn in as Judge of High Court of A.P. w.e.f. 24.06.2004., Nominated as the Executive Chairman of Telangana State Legal Services Authority, Hyderabad w.e.f. the forenoon of 15-07-2015., Apppointed as the Chief Justice of High Court of Gujarat and sworn-in as such on the forenoon of 13-02-2016.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE RAMESH RANGANATHAN
Biodata: Born on 28.07.1958 in New Delhi, Graduated in the year 1977, completed his Post Graduation in Commerce in the year 1981. He is also a qualified Chartered Accountant and a Company Secretary. He obtained Law Degree from Bangalore University and enrolled as an Advocate in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh in November, 1985. He was a Government Pleader from 1996 to 2000, and the Addl. Advocate General from July, 2000 to May, 2004. He appeared for several companies and statutory bodies including the N.T.R. University of Health Sciences, Visakhapatnam Port Trust, Singareni Collieries Company Limited, Power Grid Corporation of India, Canara Bank Voltas Limited etc. He was elevated as an Addl. Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court on 26th May, 2005. Appointed as a Permanent Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court on 20-02-2006 F.N. Nominated as the Executive Chairman of Andhra Pradesh Legal Services Authority, Hyderabad w.e.f. the forenoon of 29-12-2015. Appointed to perform the duties of the Office of the Chief Justice, High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh w.e.f. the forenoon of 30-07-2016. Transferred to High Court of Uttarakhand and assumed charge on 02/11/2018 as Chief Justice of the High Court of Uttarakhand at Nainital. Retired on 27/07/2020.
