Name: Sri Justice Rao Raghunandan Rao
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice R Raghunandan Rao was born on 30.06.1964 to Late. Sri. Rao Chinna Rao and Smt. R.Vilasitha Kumari. His Lordship did his schooling in Hyderabad Public School, Ramanthapur, Hyderabad and graduation from Nagarjuna University in Commerce and completed his Law course from Osmania University in the year 1988. Eenrolled as a Member of the Bar Council of the State of Andhra Pradesh on 01.09.1988 and commenced his practice by joining the chambers of Mr. S. Ravi. His Lordship was Assistant Government Pleader (Commercial Taxes) from 1993 to1994 and was the Special Assistant Government Pleader in the office of the Advocate General of Andhra Pradesh in 1995. His Lordship was previously Standing Counsel for various public sector corporations including M/s. Powergrid Corporation, M/s. Indian Oil Corporation, M/s. Gas Authority of India Limited and other private sector corporations till being designated as Senior Counsel. His Lordship was designated as Senior Counsel by the Hon'ble High Court of Andhra Pradesh in December 2013 and was a designated Senior Advocate, with over 30 years of experience at the Bar. His Lordship appeared regularly before the Hon'ble High Court of Telangana at Hyderabad, Hon'ble High Court of A.P. at Amaravati and the National Company Law Tribunal, Hyderabad Bench, and appeared before the other Hon'ble High Courts and the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India on some occasions. His Lordship regularly practiced in all branches of Law. His Lordship was empanelled as a member of the Senior Standing Counsel Panel for the Union of India in the Hon'ble High Court of Telangana, and was also the Senior Standing Counsel to the Hon'ble High Court of Andhra Pradesh. His Lordship sworn as Judge of the Hon'ble High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 13.01.2020. His Lordship's daughter and son are pursuing studies in Pune.

Name: SRI JUSTICE S. MADHUSUDAN RAO
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice S. Madhusudan Rao was born on 5.10,1920. Had his early education at Upper Middle School, Salur at Upper High School, Parvathipuram. Had his College Education at Mrs. A.V.N. College, Visakhapatnam. Took his Law Degree from Law College, Poona with distinction in Hindu Law and Transfer of Property and secured first rank. Enrolled as an Advocate of the High Court of Madras in April, 1943. Did Civil and Criminal work, mostly sessions work at Visakhapatnam and Srikakulam. In 1958 he was appointed by the Government as Special Public Prosecutor to conduct the ‘Kalivaram Dacoity Case’. Was directly recruited as a District and Sessions Judge in June 1959 and worked a such till July, 1969 when he was promoted as Grade-I District Judge. Worked as Chairman, Tribunal for Disciplinary Proceedings, Hyderabad, Chief Judge City Civil Court and Principal Sessions Judge, Hyderabad. In February 1972 he represented the State of Andhra Pradesh at the All India Seminar of District Judges held at Bombay. Appointed as permanent Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh w.e.f. 17.10.1974.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE S. OBUL REDDI
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice S. Obul Reddi was born on 9th April, 1916. Educated at Board High School, Nandalur, Government Arts College, Anantapur, Presidency College Madras and Law College, Madras. Enrolled as an Advocate on 26th July, 1943. Appointed as District and Sessions Judge, Grade-II from 15th January, 1955 to 8th December,1959 and as District and Sessions Judge, Grade I from 9th December, 1959 onwards. Worked as Registrar, High Court of Andhra Pradesh from 10th April, 1957 to 30th April, 1959., Appointed as Additional Judge, Andhra Pradesh High Court for 2 years from 8th July, 1966. Appointed as permanent Judge on 22nd April, 1967. Appointed as Permanent Judge on 22nd April, 1967., Appointed as Chief Justice of Andhra Pradesh High Court on 1st June, 1974. Acted as Governor of Andhra Pradesh from 26th January, 1975 to 10th January, 1976. Transferred as chief justice of Gujarat High Court on 7th July, 1976. Name: SRI JUSTICE S. RAVI KUMAR
Biodata: Born on 10th September, 1954 to late Sri Sundara Rao, District Judge Retired and Smt. Seshavathi. Obtained B.Com. Degree from Osmania University and B.L. Degree from Andhra University, Visakhapatnam. Enrolled as an Advocate on 18-12-1980. Practised on Civil and Criminal side in all Courts at Rajahmundry. Appointed as District Munsif and joined on 7-10-1985. Worked at Narsaraopeta, Visakhkapatnam and Eluru. Promoted as Senior Civil Judge in 1991 and worked in that capacity at Amalapuram, Eluru and Hyderabad. Worked as Deputy Director of A.P.Judicial Academy in the year 1997. Promoted as District & Sessions Judge in 1997 and joined as I Additional District Judge, Machilipatnam on 31-12-1997. Worked as Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Vijayawada, I Additional M.S.J., Hyderabad, Spl.Judge for C.B.I. Cases, Hyderabad, III Additional District Judge, Tirupathi, Principal District & Sessions Judge, Krishna at Machilipatnam, Principal District & Sessions Judge, Chittoor. Worked as Member Secretary, A.P.State Legal Services Authority, Hyderabad. Elevated as Additional Judge, High Court of A.P., Hyderabad. Sworn in as Additional Judge of High Court of A.P. on 23-10-2013. He is married to Smt.Lakshmi and the couple is blessed with two sons Master Shoumik and Master Koushik., Appointed as Judge of High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on the afternoon of 02-03-2016., Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on the afternoon of 09-09-2016.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE S.ASHOK KUMAR
Biodata: Born on 20.07.1947 to late Mr. S.Santhiagu and late Mrs. Savariammai both were teachers. Native Place is Tenkulam Pudur, Tirunelveli District. Wife's name is Mrs. Ebi Ashok Kumar, M.A. of Karungulam, Tirunelveli District. Have four children, two sons and two daughters., Studied st Form to P.U.C. at St. Xavier's High School and College, Palayamkottai; B.Sc., at St. John's College, Palayamkottai; M.Sc., at St. Joseph's College, Trichy and B.L. at Law College, Madras., Practised at Tirunelveli Bar from 1971 to 1987., Appointed as directly recruited District and Sessions Judge on 16.11.1987. Government Pleader, High Court, Madras; His wife is Mrs. Mahalakshmi Prabakar, consultant Psychologist in Apollo Hospitals, Chennai and National Institute of Fashion Technology at Chennai., Daughters are: (1) Mrs. Bobby Arun, wife of Mr. P.Arun Rajendran (Son-in-law), Executive in HCL Technologies at Chennai, son of Mr. P.Rajendran, Director General of Police of Tamil Nadu. (2) Miss A.Mary Brinda, B.Tech, and M.Sc., in Molecular and Genetic Medicine in England and employed in United Kingdom., Assumed charge as a Judge of A.P. High Court on transfer from Madras High Court on 24.03.2008 F.N., Retired as Judge, High Court of A.P., on attaining the age of superannuation on 20.07.2009 F.N.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE S.V.BHATT
Biodata: Born in the year 1962 at Madanapalle, Chittoor District, to Sri Ramakrishnaiah and Smt.Annapurnamma. Had his primary education at Giri Rao Theosophical High School, Madanapalle and is a Graduate in Commerce from Beasant Theosophical College, Madanapalle. Did his Bachelor's Degree in Law from Jagadguru Renukacharya College, Bangalore. Enrolled with Bar Council of A.P in 1987 and joined the office of Sri E.Kalyanram. He has practiced on civil and original side of High Court. He was Standing Counsel for Hindustan Shipyard Limited, A.P.Pollution Control Board, BHEL, BEL, BHPV, RSVP and National Maritime University. Worked as Special Government Pleader in the office of Advocate General during 2000-2003. Sworn in as an Additional Judge of the High Court of A.P on 12th April, 2013. Appointed as Judge of the High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on 08.09.2014. Sworn in as Judge of Kerala High Court on 19.03.2019.

Name: SRI JUSTICE SAMUDR. LA GOVINDA RAJULU
Biodata: Born on 6th August, 1951 to Sri Samudrala Nagaiah and Smt Samudrala Nagaratnamma. Had his primary education in Municipal Elementary School, Patnul Street, Tirupathi and Secondary Education in Municipal High School and Sri Venkateswara High School, Tirupathi. Passed H.S.L.C in April 1967. Studied B.Sc., Degree (Maths, Physics and Chemistry) at Sri Venkateswara Arts College, Tirupathi. Passed B.L. in the year 1973 from Sri Venkateswara University College, Tirupathi. Obtained First Class in all 3 years of Law Degree. Attained First Rank in B.L. examinations from Sri Venkateswara University, Tirupathi., Enrolled as Advocate in September, 1973. Practiced as Advocate at Tirupathi Courts for 8 months and then shifted practice to the High Court of Andhra Pradesh in June, 1974. Elected as Executive Member of A.P. High Court's Advocates Association in the year 1978., Joined in judicial service as District Munsif in November, 1979. Worked in the cadre of District Munsif at Narsapur, West Godavari, Pattipadu, East Godavari and Vijayawada. Subsequently promoted as Sub Judge in August, 1988. Worked as Sub Judge at Gudivada and Rajahmundry. Appointed as District Judge (Grade-II) by transfer in September, 1993. Worked as Additional District Judge in Prakasam at Ongole, I Additional District Judge, West Godavari District at Eluru. Worked as Special Judge for C.B.I Cases, Visakhapatnam and worked as Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge for trial of Jublee Hills Car Bomb Blast Case, Hyderabad. Worked as Chief Legal Advisor to Additional Director General of Police, C.I.D., in Home Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh for three years., Elected as President of Andhra Pradesh Judicial Officers’ Association in the years 2003 and 2006 for two consecutive terms. Promoted as District Judge (Grade-I), District Judge, (Selection Grade) and District Judge (Super Time Scale). Worked as Principal District Judge of Vizianagaram District, Adilabad District and East Godavari District at Rajahmundry. Worked as Metropolitan Sessions Judge at Hyderabad till elevation to the Bench of High Court of A.P., Elevated as Additional Judge of High Court of A.P. on 14-10-2009. Appointed as Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such, on 26-11-2010. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on the afternoon of 05-08-2013.]
Other_Bachelors_Degree: B. Sc.  Maths, Physics and Chemistry

Name: SRI JUSTICE SATYABRATA SINHA
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Satyabrata Sinha was born on August 8, 1944 at Dhanbad in State of Bihar, India. He passed Matriculation Examination from H.E. School, Dhanbad. Obtained B.L. Name: SRI JUSTICE SURESH KUMAR KAIT
Biodata: Justice Suresh Kumar Kait was born on May 24, 1963 at Village Kakaut, Distt. Kaithal, Haryana, India. Graduated in Humanities from University College Kurukshetra. During graduation, he was selected as Unit Leader in National Service Scheme NSS and was also awarded University Merit Certificate. Post-Graduated in Political Science from Kurukshetra University. During Post-Graduation, he was elected as Joint Secretary of Students’ Union, Kurukshetra University. He obtained Bachelor's Degree in Law from Campus Law Centre, University of Delhi and was enrolled as an Advocate in the year 1989. Justice Kait is the first in his family to become an Advocate. He had been the Panel Lawyer/Senior Counsel for Union of India, U.P.S.C. and Railways. He was appointed as Standing Counsel for Central Government in the year 2004 and continued so till his elevation as Additional Judge of Delhi High Court on 05.09.2008. Became a Permanent Judge of the Delhi High Court on 12.04.2013. Assumed charge on 12.04.2016 as Judge of the High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh.]
LLB_Institutition: Faculty of Law, University of Delhi

Name: SRI JUSTICE SYED SHAH MOHAMMED QUADRI
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Syed Shah Mohammed Quadri, born on April 5, 1938; Education: B.A., LL.B from Osmania University, Hyderabad (A.P); LL.M from University of London; Specialization in Taxation, Company Law and Islamic Law; Bar at Law from Lincoln's Inn; Enrolled as an Advocate on 7th January, 1963; Practised both on original side in Trial Courts and on appellate side in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh; Was a Part Time Lecturer in College of Law, Osmania University from December, 1972 to October, 1981; Worked as Government Pleader in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh at Hyderabad from October, 1981 to July, 1986; Appointed Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh in July, 1986; Was for sometime Dean, Faculty of Law Kakatiya University, A.P. Was also a Member of the Board of Governors, Andhra Pradesh Judicial Academy; Was Executive Chairman, Andhra Pradesh State Legal Services Authority;, Worked as the Acting Chief Justice of High Court of Andhra Pradesh from November 3, 1997 to December 3, 1997; He delivered many judgements on consititutional law, taxation, civil law and criminal law., Appointed as a Judge of Supreme Court of India on December 4, 1997. Is an Executive Member, National Academy of Legal Studies and Research University NALSAR, Univerity of Law, Hyderabad. He has been a member of collegium of the Hon'ble Supreme Court. Held the position of the Chairman of the Supreme Court Legal Services Committee on January 1, 2003. Retired as the Judge of the Supreme Court of India on April 5, 2003., Appointed as Chairman, Authority for Advance Rulings (Income-tax) with full additional charge of Chairperson for Authority for Advance Rulings (Customs & Central Excise) on 27th January, 2004 and working as such from February 4, 2004.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE T AMARNATH GOUD
Court: High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh
Biodata: Monday, January 17,2022, Honourable Sri Justice T.Amarnath Goud was born on 01-03-1965 at Secunderabad to Sri T.Krishna and Smt.Savitri. Had School education in St.Patricks High School, Secunderabad, Intermediate in Wesley boys Junior College, Secunderabad, B.Sc., Degree from Arts and Science College, Secunderabad, (Osmania University, Hyderabad) and LL.B., from Shivaji Law College, Maratwada University, Maharastra. Enrolled as Advocate on 22-09-1990 in the Bar Council of A.P. Joined the Chambers of Honourable Sri Justice V.Eswaraiah (then was Advocate). Actively practiced in Civil, Criminal, Constitutional and all other branches of Law and also Standing Counsel for Nalgonda District Co-operative Central Bank Limited. Honourable High Court has appointed him as Arbitrator, Amicus Curie and Advocate Commissioner in several cases and also Panel Lawyer for A.P. High Court Legal Services Committee. Was Honourary President of Human Rights Protection Organisation, Hyderabad. Served A.P. High Court Advocates Bar Association, Hyderabad as Vice President, Joint Secretary, Treasurer and also as Executive Committee Member. Was a Lion for the last 18 years in Lions Clubs International (Lions Club of Secunderabad Millennuium Disc 320C) and Trustee of Heart and Eye Foundation, Trustee of Lions Bhavan, Hyderabad. Served as Region Chairperson, Zonal Chairperson and District Chairperson in Lions Clubs International. Belongs to the family of Philanthropist. Grand father Sri T.Anjaiah Goud (owner of Paradise Theatre, Secunderabad) donated land for burial ground at Kavadiguda, Hyderabad and also statue of Mahatma Gandhi at M.G.Road, Secunderabad, which was unveiled by the then Honourable Prime Minister of India Sri Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru in the year 1951. Elevated as Judge of High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh on 21-09-2017. Transferred as Judge of Tripura High Court at Agartala and assumed charge of office on the afternoon of 28-10-2021.

Name: SRI JUSTICE T.SUNIL CHOWDARY
Biodata: Born on 04th February, 1957 to Sri Venkatadri and Smt.Veeramma at Karamchedu, Prakasam District, in agricultural family. Did his Primary and Secondary School Education at Karamchedu and studied Intermediate in VRS & YRN College, Chirala. Did B.Com., in Andhra Layola College, Vijayawada and B.L., in Andhra University, Visakhapatnam. Enrolled as an Advocate on 02.3.1984 and joined the Office of Sri P.Venkatadri at Chirala. Shifted practice to High Court in 1988 and joined the chamber of Sri J.Chelameshwar (now, Hon'ble Judge, Supreme Court of India). Standing Counsel – for Navodaya Vidyalaya Samithi from 1991 to 1997, for South Central Railway in 1997, and also worked as Special Government Pleader attached to Advocate General from 18.12.1995 to 31.12.1997. Married Sailaja, who is an Advocate, and blessed with two daughters – Sneha and Sruthi. Appointed as District & Sessions Judge (direct recruitment) in the year 1998 and worked at various places as – Chairman, LRAT-cum-III Additional District Judge, Karimnagar, IV Additional District Judge, Visakhapatnam, III Additional District Judge, Kakinada, I Additional District Judge, Guntur, Principal District Judge, Kurnool. Also worked as Registrar Administration, Registrar Vigilance and Registrar General in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh from 21.12.2009 to 22.10.2013. Elevated as Additional Judge, High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad on 23.10.2013. Appointed as Judge of High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on the afternoon of 02-03-2016. Laid down office on 03.02.2019 on attaining the age of superannuation.

Name: SRI JUSTICE TAMADA GOPALA KRISHNA
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Tamada Gopala Krishna was born on 11th April, 1949 to late Suryanarayana, a distinguished Advocate and an illustrious father, had his early education at Parvathipuram and Bobbili in Vizianagaram District. Before elevation to the Bench, he was the Standing Counsel for Visakhapatnam Port Trust and Visakhapatnam Dock Labour Board. He was elected as the President of the Andhra Pradesh High Court Advocates’ Association for the year 2000-2001. Elevated as a Additional Judge of Andhra Pradesh High Court and sworn on 10.09.2001 and appointed as permanent Judge on 31.07.2002. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on 10.04.2011.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE THOTTATHIL B. NAIR RADHAKRISHNAN
Biodata: Monday, January 17,2022, Thottathil B. Radhakrishnan was sworn-in as permanent Judge of the High Court of Kerala on 14th October, 2004. He is the son of late N. Bhaskaran Nair and late K. Parukutty Amma, both Advocates, who practised at Kollam. Born on 29th April, 1959, he had his early schooling in St. Josephs Convent and Government Boys High School, Kollam Arya Central School, Thiruvananthapuram and secured ISC conferred by the University of Cambridge (Local Examination Syndicate), having studied in Trinity Lyceum, Kollam. After obtaining B.Sc. Degree in Zoology from University of Kerala as a student of the Fatima Matha National College, Kollam, he secured LL.B. Degree from Bangalore University having studied Law in K.G.F. Law College, Kolar Gold Fields. Enrolled on 11th December, 1983, he practised at Thiruvananthapuram as junior to Advocate late P. Ramakrishna Pillai and thereafter shifted to High Court of Kerala in 1988 as junior to Senior Advocate late P. Sukumaran Nayar. He dealt with cases in different branches of law, the areas of his prominent practice being Civil, Constitutional and Administrative Law. He appeared also for various institutions including banks, university and other public institutions. He also appeared for the High Court of Kerala. He was appointed as amicus curiae in different matters and was Advocate-Member of the Rule Committee constituted under Section 123 of the Code of Civil Procedure. While an Advocate, he was invited as Resource Person by the Training Directorate which later became the Kerala Judicial Academy. He also addressed various programmes of Legal Services Authority and training programmes for Advocates. As Judge, he was nominated by the Honourable the Chief Justice to deal with original petitions registered following directions of the Supreme Court in relation to mental health matters. He was the President of the Board of Governors of the Kerala State mediation and Conciliation Centre and the President of the Kerala Judicial Academy. On various occasions, he was invited as Resource Person to the National Judicial Academy, Bhopal and the Kerala Judicial Academy. He had also attended various national conferences on different subjects of critical importance. He was the Executive Chairman of the Kerala State Legal Services Authority, the Executive Chairman of the Lakshadweep State Legal Services Authority, the Chairman of the Law Reporting Council, I.L.R. (Kerala Series) and the President of the Rule Committee under Section 123 of the Code of Civil Procedure. He is a Member of the Central Authority of the National Legal Services Authority. He was the Acting Chief Justice of the High Court of Kerala from 13.05.2016 to 1.8.2016 and from the afternoon of 16.2.2017 till he was sworn in as Chief Justice of the Chhattisgarh High Court in the forenoon of 18.3.2017. He was the Chief Justice of the Chhattisgarh High Court from 18.3.2017 to 6.7.2018. He was the Chancellor of the Hidayatullah National Law University, Naya Raipur, Chhattishgarh. He was sworn in as Chief Justice of the High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the States of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh on 7.7.2018. He is the Chancellor of the National Academy for Legal Studies And Research, University of Law, Hyderabad and the Damodaram Sanjivayya National Law University, Visakhapatnam. He is the Patron-in-Chief of the Telangana and Andhra Pradesh States Legal Services Authority. He is the Chief Patron of the A.P. Judicial Academy, Secunderabad. Transferred as the Chief Justice of the Calcutta High Court and Sworn-in as as such on the forenoon of 04-04-2019.]

Name: Sri Justice U.Durga Prasad Rao
Biodata: Born in Advocates’ family on 12.08.1962. Paternal grand father Sri Upmaka Narayana Murthy was a reputed lawyer and Sathavadhani in Parvathipuram, Vizianagaram District. Maternal grand father Sri Voleti Kameswar Rao and his brothers Sri Seetharam Murthy and Sri Laxmoji Rao were also Lawyers. Wife Smt.Perin Devi and father-in-law Sri A. Narsimham are Lawyers. After completion of law joined in the office of maternal grand father Sri Voleti Seetharam Murthy in 1986 and practised in Parvathipuram, Bobbili, Vizianagaram and Srikakulam Districts. Did L.L.M in Constitutional Law, Crimes and Torts. Selected as Additional District Judge (Direct Recruitment) in 1998 and held different posts including Principal District Judge, Karimnagar, Kurnool, Additional Director, A.P. Judicial Academy, Registrar Judicial, Central Project Coordinator etc., Elevated as Additional Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh and sworn in on 23rd October, 2013. Appointed as Judge of High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the State of Telangana and the State of Andhra Pradesh and assumed charge as such on the afternoon of 02-03-2016.

Name: SRI JUSTICE UJJAL BHUYAN
Biodata: Born on 2nd August, 1964 at Guwahati.His father Suchendra Nath Bhuyan was a Senior Advocate and a former Advocate General of Assam. Did his schooling in Don Bosco High School, Guwahati and thereafter studied in Cotton College, Guwahati. After graduating in Arts from Kirori Mal College, Delhi, he obtained his LL.B. degree from Government Law College, Guwahati and LL.M. degree from Gauhati University, Guwahati. Was enrolled on 20-03-1991 with the Bar Council of Assam, Nagaland, Meghalaya, Manipur, Tripura, Mizoram and Arunachal Pradesh. Had practiced before the Principal Seat of the Gauhati High Court at Guwahati and appeared before the Agartala, Shillong, Kohima and Itanagar Benches of the Gauhati High Court. Also practiced before the Central Administrative Tribunal, Guwahati Bench and the Assam Board of Revenue. Appeared before the Labour Court, Guwahati, various Civil Courts and the State Consumer Forum, Arunachal Pradesh. He was the Standing Counsel of the Income Tax Department for long 16 years starting as Junior Standing Counsel since May, 1995 and subsequently appointed as Senior Standing Counsel of the Income Tax Department on 03-12-2008. He was the Additional Government Advocate, Meghalaya in the Principal Seat of the Gauhati High Court from April, 2002 to October, 2006. He was engaged as Special Counsel of the Forest Department, Government of Arunachal Pradesh from December, 2005 to April, 2009. Appointed as Standing Counsel of Gauhati High Court on 03-03-2010. Designated as Senior Advocate by the Gauhati High Court on 06-09-2010. He was appointed as Additional Advocate General, Assam on 21-07-2011. Was a member of Gauhati High Court Bar Association, Lawyers Association, Guwahati, Bar Association of India, All India Federation of Tax Practitioners and Indian Law Institute, Assam Chapter. Appointed as Additional Judge of Gauhati High Court on 17th October, 2011 and confirmed on 20th March, 2013. He was also the Executive Chairman of Mizoram State Legal Services Authority. Justice Ujjal Bhuyan was closely associated with the Judicial Academy, Assam and National Law University, Guwahati. Transferred to Bombay High Court and took oath as Judge of Bombay High Court on 03.10.2019. After a two year stint at Mumbai, transferred to Telangana High Court and took oath as Judge of Telangana High Court on 22.10.2021. He is also the Executive Chairman of Telangana State Legal Services Authority.

Name: SRI JUSTICE V. MADHAVA RAO
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice V. Madhava Rao was born on 10.10.1922. Had early education at Middle School, Huzurabad and High School, Warangal. Studied Intermediate at Government College, Warangal. Name: SRI JUSTICE V. PARTHASARATHI
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice V. Parthasarathi was born on 06.03.1910. Took his B.A., Degree in Economics from Government Arts College, Rajahmundry standing first in the University. Took his Law Degree from the Madras Law College, and joined the Chambers of Sri prattipati Satyanarayana Rao. Duly profited by his contacts with the then Stalwarts of the Bar including late Sri V. Govindaraja Chari and established a lucrative practice, having enrolled as an Advocate of Madras High Court on 11.8.1932. Was a Legal Advisor to several institutions including the Life Insurance Corporation of India. Practised till 1954 at Madras and later at Guntur till 1956 and from 1956 at Hyderabad. Made his mark in other fields of Human endeavour, particularly Co-operation, Banking and Insurance. Was the Director of Andhra Bank from 1961 to 1967. He was a director and Chairman of the Board of Directors of the South India Co-operative Insurance Society. Was President of the Andhra Pradesh High Court Advocates Association Co-operative Society. Was appointed as a Judge of the Andhra Pradesh High Court from 5th April, 1968. Retired on 6.3.1972.]

Law degree from Madras University, Madras. Enrolled as an advocate in the year 1960, joined in the chamber of Sri A. Bhujanga Rao, after same timejoined in the office of Sri B. Bala Mukunda Reddy. Name: SRI JUSTICE V.ESWARAIAH
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice V. Eswaraiah was born on 10th March, 1951 at Nemillakalva Village, Valigonda Mandal, Nalgonda District of Andhra Pradesh, India. Father: Late Sri Vangala Anjaiah and mother: Smt. Lakshmi Narsamaba., Studied in Z.P. High School at Valigonda up to SSC and Intermediate in Junior College, Ramanapet, B.Sc. from City Science College at Hyderabad and did the Law from Law College of Osmania University. Enrolled as an Advocate in 1978. Practised as lawyer mainly in High court and Civil Courts in Hyderabad. Handled several Civil, Criminal and Constitution matters. Worked as Government Pleader for 5 years from January, 1990 to December, 1994 and was Standing Counsel of A.P.D.D.C.L. and Nalgonda District co-op. Central Bank, etc., He was appointed as Additional Judge, High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 17.5.1999 and Judge w.e.f. 20.4.2000. Appointed to perform the duties of the Office of the Chief Justice, High Court of Andhra Pradesh w.e.f. 04.06.2012 F.N. to 24.06.2012 A.N., Appointed to perform the duties of the Office of the Chief Justice, High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Hyderabad w.e.f. 08.03.2013 F.N. and Retired as such on attaining the age of Superannuation on the afternoon of 09-03-2013.

Name: SRI JUSTICE V.RAMASUBRAMANIAN
Biodata: Monday, January 17,2022, Born on June 30, 1958. Passed B.Sc from Vivekananda College in Chennai. After graduating in Law from the Madras Law College, enrolled as a Member of the Bar on February 16, 1983. Practiced for almost 23 years in High Court of Madras, City and Small Causes Court, State Consumer Commission and District Consumer Forum, Central and State Administrative Tribunals, Chennai, in Civil and Constitutional matters and specialized in service matters. Was appointed as an Additional Judge of the Madras High Court on July 31, 2006 and as a permanent Judge on November 9, 2009. Was transferred on his own request to the High Court of Judicature at Hyderabad for the States of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh with effect from April 27, 2016. After the bifurcation and the creation of a separate High Court for the State of Andhra Pradesh, was retained as a Judge of the High Court of Telangana at Hyderabad w.e.f. January 1, 2019. Was sworn in as the Chief Justice of Himachal Pradesh High Court on 22nd June, 2019. Relinquished the charge on 23.09.2019 forenoon on being elevated as a Judge of Honourable Supreme Court of India.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE V.SURI APPA RAO
Biodata: Born on 01-7-1952 in an agricultural family from Nagulapalli village of Visakhapatnam district. His parents are Smt. Parvathamma and Late Sri Konda Babu. Had his earlier education up to degree at Nagulapalli and Anakapalli of Visakhapatnam District. Obtained Law Degree from Andhra University, Visakhapatnam in the year 1976.He was enrolled as an Advocate in August, 1976 and practised at Anakapalli and Visakhapatnam Courts. Later, joined in the judicial service as Munsif Magistrate on 10-4-1981. Promoted as Subordinate Judge in the year 1989. On promotion as District Judge in 1995, worked as Additional District Judge, Guntur; Additional Director of Prosecutions, Hyderabad; Additional Director, A.P. Judicial Academy, Secunderabad, I Additional District Judge, Sangareddy and Ranga Reddy. Worked as Principal District Judge, Nizamabad and Krishna at Machilipatnam, and Law Secretary for the State Government of Andhra Pradesh., On behalf of the Government of Andhra Pradesh, he represented the team of delegates to study the Revenue Laws at Australia and New Zealand in 2008. Thereafter, the Government of Andhra Pradesh introduced "BHUBHARATHI SCHEME" for aerial survey and land titling and the same was approved by the Government of India, which agreed to introduce the said Scheme throughout the India., Sworn in as an Additional Judge of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 15-11-2010. Transferred as an Additional Judge of Karnataka High Court and relinquished the charge as an Additional Judge of Andhra Pradesh on 20-04-2011. Appointed as permanent Judge on 19-01-2012 F.N. Re-transferred to the High Court of Andhra Pradesh and sworn-in on 07-11-2013 F.N. Retired on attaining the age of Superannuation on the afternoon of 30-06-2014.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE V.V.S.RAO
Biodata: Vakkala Venkata Subba Rao, better known as V.V.S.Rao of the High Court of Adnhra Pradesh was born on the 11th of July 1950 in a remote place known as Giddaluru. The Justice's extensive education began at Sri Venkateswara University where he was awarded a B.Sc. in Botany, Zoology and Chemistry along with a B.Ed. He then attended the University of Saugar (now Dr. Hari Singh Gour University) where he was awarded a M.A. in Criminology and Forensic Science with the Dr. Ganesh Ram Mukharia Gold Medal for achieving the highest marks in the course. It was at this time that he also gained an LL.B degree., From 1977 to 1980 Justice Rao worked for the Government owned Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation as an Assistant Regional Manager, although he left to practice law. The Justice was admitted to the Andhra Pradesh State Bar Council in 1980 and was designated a Senior Advocate in November 1996 during which time he practiced in administrative law, constitutional law, civil law and service law appearing on many significant cases in the High Court of Andhra Pradesh. He was standing counsel for the National Institute of Rural Development, another Government owned entity, from 1991 until 1996. In addition, he was standing counsel for High Court of Judicature of Andhra Pradesh from 1987 until 1999., Justice Rao also acted as the Vice-President of the All Indian Lawyer's Union from 1996-1998 as well as Vice-President and Acting President of the Andhra Pradesh Chapter of the International Jurists Organisation from 1995-1997. During this time he also served on the Indo-US Legal Study Team and a sub-committee which reported on the civil judicial process., In 1999 Justice Rao was made an Additional Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh and was made a permanent member less than a year later in April 2000. In October 2006 Justice Rao began a relationship with the National Judicial Academy part of which involves him delivering seminars, workshops and other training programs. As part of this programme he was involved in an informal group of judges who reported to the Supreme Court of India on ‘Strengthening Judicial Systems Management’., Justice Rao was member of Judicial Delegation led by Hon'ble the Chief Justice of India, that visited Australia from 18 to 26 September, 2009 and participated in ‘Australia – India International Cooperation Programme on Protection of Rights and improving Access to Justice’, Sydney. Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on the afternoon of 10.07.2012.]
Other_Bachelors_Degree: B. Sc.  Botany, Zoology and Chemistry

Name: SRI JUSTICE VAMAN RAO
Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Vaman Rao was born on 9th May 1939 in Adilabad District, Andhra Pradesh, India. He obtained degree in B.Sc., Agriculture from A.P. Agricultural University, Hyderabad and LL.B. from Osmania University, Hyderabad. Enrolled as Advocate in July, 1962. Practiced on Civil as well as Criminal side for 11 years at Adilabad. Joined as District Munsif on 5.11.1973. Promoted as Subordinate Judge in January 1978 and as District Judge Gr.II in March 1983. Worked for brief period as Faculty Member, Law Academy at Hyderabad. Additional District Judge, Nalgonda, Member, Tribunal for Disciplinary Proceedings, Registrar Lokayukta, Prl. District Judge, Kurnool, Registrar Special Court under A.P. Land Grabbing Prohibition Act and as Principal District Judge, Visakhapatnam. Worked as Registrar Judicial, Registrar (Admn.) and Registrar General, High Court of A.P., Hyderabad. Subsequently worked as Chief Judge, City Civil Court, Hyderabad. Appointed as Additional Judge of A.P. High Court on 27.4.1998 and as Judge w.e.f. 20.4.2000. Retired on 09.05.2001.]

Name: SRI JUSTICE VILAS V.AFZULPURKAR
Biodata: Born at Pune on 02.03.1954 and later after obtaining B.Sc. Degree did LL.B., at M.P. Law College, Aurangabad, Marathwada University in June, 1976. Returned to native place-Hyderabad-for practicing law and enrolled as an Advocate on 07.10.1976. Worked in the Chambers of late Sri M.L. Ganu, who was a leading Lawyer on the civil side. Worked initially for 2 years in the City Civil Courts and later shifted to High Court in the year 1978. Has been practicing in the High Court as well as in the Supreme Court since then and has vast experience in various matters on civil side, constitutional law, Labour and Industrial laws, Companies Act etc. Was designated as Senior Counsel by the Honourable High Court of A.P. in December, 2005. Since then has appeared as Senior Counsel in various matters. Also represented as Counsel for the State of Karnataka. Has been Adviser and Counsel to High Court of A.P., V.V.Educational Society, A.P.Markfed, A.P.Oilfed, ING Vysya Bank Ltd., etc. Had sworn as Additional Judge of Hounourable High Court of A.P. on 08.08.2008., Assumed charge as Permanent Judge of High Court of Andhra Pradesh on 20.01.2010., Retired on attaining the age of superannuation on the afternoon of 01-03-2016.]
LLB_Institutition: M.P. Law College, Aurangabad, Marathwada University

Biodata: Hon'ble Sri Justice Y. Venkateswara Rao was born on 31st October, 1909. Name: SRI. JUSTICE JOYMALYA BAGCHI
Biodata: Born on 3rd October, 1966. Did his schooling from Calcutta Boys' School. Passed LLB (Five Years' Course) from Calcutta University in 1991. Stood first in all the LLB examinations. Name: Sudhir Singh
Biodata: His Lordship was elevated to the bench as an Additional Judge of the Patna High Court on 15th April, 2015. He was sworn in as a Permanent Judge on 20th April, 2016. He was enrolled as an advocate in 1991. He appeared as Central Government Counsel for the Union of India, Railway Advocate for Ministry of Railways (Railway Board), Additional Standing Counsel for the Indian Audit and Accounts Department and Assistant Solicitor General of India at Patna High Court. Predominantly, he appeared in Criminal and Writ matters. His Lordship comes from a family of legal luminaries. His great grandfather, Late Nand Kishore Prasad Singh practised at the District Court, Chapra. His grandfather, Late Baldeo Prasad Singh, Bar-at-Law, practised at the Patna High Court, Patna and was the President of the Barrister's Association for a long period of time. His father, Justice N.P. Singh, is a Former Judge of The Supreme Court of India and was also the Chairman of Cauvery Water Dispute Tribunal.

After completing school education, he completed his graduation in Commerce faculty from Balbhim College, Beed. He was a student of M.P. Law College, Aurangabad and obtained degree in law (LL.B.). He joined the legal profession in the year 1982, practiced on both Civil and Criminal sides in the District and Sessions Court at Beed, for 18 years. He was selected as an Additional District Judge and appointed on the said post at Osmanabad on 6.10.2000 and worked as such till 31.12.2003. He was the Registrar at Nagpur Bench of Bombay High Court from 01.01.2004 to 16.5.2006. Thereafter he worked as District Judge-3 from 17.5.2006 to 11.6.2006 and District Judge-4 from 12.6.2006 to 2.6.2007 in the District and Sessions Court at Aurangabad. Thereafter, he worked as Member Secretary of Maharashtra State Legal Services Authority MALSA, Bombay from 4.6.2007 to 29.2.2008. He was posted as Principal District Judge at Osmanabad from 5.3.2008 to 10.2.2009. He also worked as Registrar Inspection at Bombay High Court from 11.2.2009 to 5.6.2010. Thereafter, he was posted as Principal District Judge at Jalna from 7.06.2010 to 12.6.2012. He has also worked as Charity Commissioner of Maharashtra State from 18.6.2012 to 2.3.2014. He is elevated as Additional Judge of Bombay High Court on 03.03.2014.

Name: V.L. ACHLIYA
Biodata: V.L. ACHLIYA B.Sc Mathematics,LL.B.,LL.M. 2013-2021 He was born on 13th February, 1959 at Village Pimpalkhuta, District Amravati in an Agriculturist family. He did his B.Sc Mathematics in the year 1981 from Shri. Brijlal Biyani Science College, Amravati and LL.B. in the year 1984 from Nagpur University in First Division with a distinction in 3 subjects. Thereafter, he did his LL.M. in the year 1988 from Pune University with specialization in Criminal and Corporate Law. He enrolled with the Bar Council of Maharashtra and Goa on 29th October, 1984. He then joined the Chambers of Late Advocate Shri. S. Z. Patil, an eminent lawyer of the region and the Dean of Faculty of Law, Amravati University. He practiced mostly on Civil and Criminal side. He also worked in Labour, Industrial, Co-operative Courts and before Revenue authorities. He was Honorary part time lecturer in Dr. Punjabrao Deshmukh College of Law, Amravati during the period 1988-1997. He also worked as an Honorary part time lecturer in Post Graduate Department of Law, Amravati University for 2 years. During the period 1985-86 he was Secretary of District Bar Association, Amravati. He was Assistant Government Pleader and Additional Public Prosecutor at Amravati during the period 1993-1997. He was a Standing Counsel for Municipal Corporation, Amravati, Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd., United Insurance Co. Ltd., National Insurance Co. Ltd., National Insurance Co. Ltd., Bank of Maharashtra, Municipal Council, Morshi and other institutions. After practising as an Advocate for 13 years, he joined the Judicial Service as a Judge, City Civil and Sessions Court, Gr. Bombay on 26th November, 1997. He worked as a Joint District and Additional Sessions Judge, Nagpur from 8th Dec, 1997 to 7th Dec, 1999. During this period he handled number of important Civil and Criminal cases. He was appointed as a Court Commissioner by High Court of Judicature of Bombay, Bench at Nagpur, to submit a report in respect of the overall conditions of inmates and under trial prisoners lodged in the Central Prison at Nagpur. After visiting Central Prison for 9 days and after interacting with more than 500 prisoners he submitted a detailed report within a record time of 15 days which was widely appreciated by the Division Bench of the High Court. The said report, provided a basis to issue various directions by High Court to State Government and other functionaries of State Government to improve the overall conditions of the prisoners as well as the Administration of Central Prison. The improvement brought about various changes which ultimately resulted into ISO Certificate to Central Prison, Nagpur. It also resulted into release of more than 600 undertrial prisoners languishing in jail for months together. During the period 8thDec, 1999 to 30th June, 2005 he worked as a Judge, City Civil and Additional Session Judge, Gr. Bombay. During this period he was assigned various important assignments on Civil as well as Criminal side. He conducted the Trial of 1997-1998 Railway Serial Bomb Blast Case which was the first Judgment in a Serial Bomb Blast Cases in Mumbai.. He was then appointed as a Designated Judge of M.P.I.D, Court, City Civil and Sessions Court, Bombay. He was posted as the Registrar, S.I.D/Vigilance, High Court, Bombay w.e.f. 1st of July, 2005 and worked there till 13th February 2009. He was then posted as Principal District and Session Judge, Pune from 16th February, 2009 to 8th March 2010. On the recommendation of High Court, the Government of Maharashtra was pleased to appoint him as the Principal Secretary and Remembrancer of Legal Affairs, Law and Judiciary Department, Government of Maharashtra. He worked on the said post from 9th March, 2010 to 20th October, 2013. During his tenure, the budgetary allocation for infrastructure development of subordinate judiciary increased from Rs. 80-90 crores to Rs. 430 crore. During his tenure, the allocation for Non-Plan expenditure to Judiciary increased manifolds. He got approved more than 500 additional posts of ministrial staff for High Court and more than 300 posts of judicial officers in Subordinate Judiciary. He also got imnplemented recommendation of Hon'ble Padmanabhan Pay Commission for Subordinate Judicial Officers and the recommendation of Hon'ble Shri. Jagannath Shetty Commission for ministerial staff of Subordinate Judiciary. He got approved the important legislations which facilitated to enhance the pecuniary jurisdiction of the Subordinate courts and City Civil Court, which has considerably reduced the pendency of cases in the High Court and paved the way for speedy disposal of cases. During his tenure he granted large number of approvals and made budgetary provisions for Court Complexes at Taluka and District places and residential quarters for the Judicial officers. All the new Court buildings and residential quarters that have been constructed in the last 4 years and under construction were approved during his tenure. He was appointed as an Additional Judge of the Bombay High Court on 21st October, 2013 and confirmed as a Judge of the Bombay High Court on 2nd March, 2016.
Other_Bachelors_Institution: Shri. Brijlal Biyani Science College, Amravati

Name: Vikash Jain
Biodata: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Vikash Jain was born on the 18th of February, 1960. Having schooled at St. Xavier's High School, Patna and St. Michael's High School, Patna, he did his graduation from Patna University. He obtained his LLB degree from Patna Law College in 1986 and enrolled with the Bihar State Bar Council in September of the same year. His field of specialization has been Taxation Laws. In June 1998, he was appointed Government Pleader - VI in the Patna High Court and served as such till March 2000. In February, 2010, he was designated Senior Advocate of the Patna High Court. He was appointed Additional Judge of the Patna High Court on the 20th of June, 2011.
